notes.title: 01.09.2025 Game update
notes.content:
Maintenance has been completed.

The following changes have been made to the game:

Dungeons:

🔹 Old dungeon stones have been removed and replaced with new ones
🔹 When selecting the Sky Fortress on the dungeon teleporter, the character is transferred to NPC High Priest Largal
🔹 The dungeon management menu has been removed from the dungeon manager NPC
🔹 The dungeon teleporter ownership menu has been updated

General Changes:

🔹 The NPC Coin Exchange Assistant now has a skill card combination menu
🔹 Resurrection window delay reduced from 5 seconds to 2 seconds
🔹 Help and Shop windows now close automatically upon death
🔹 Mounts can now be mounted/dismounted with a double-click or a hotkey (same as equipment)
🔹 Added commands:
  /ride — mount/dismount
  /sit — sit/stand

Interface:

🔹 Added quick access icons for key functions (e.g., guild buffs)
🔹 Management window opens with the T key
🔹 Updated commands linked to icons
🔹 Tooltips now display relevant commands when hovering over an icon

Guilds:

🔹 Maximum guild level increased to 20
🔹 Leveling beyond 16 costs 256M rupees
🔹 New guild buff buttons added: +10% and +15%
🔹 Guild level can only be raised once per week (resets on Monday at 00:00)
🔹 From level 10 onwards, 300 raid medals are required to level up
🔹 Required guild points for raids:

Ancient City Ruins — 10.0

Sky Fortress — 15.0

Twilight Dungeon — 20.0
🔹 Minimum guild level for raids: 10
🔹 Raids now drop Raid Medals in small amounts along with items

Raids & Sieges:

🔹 Low-level dungeon raids and sieges have been removed
🔹 Three new raid dungeons added:

Ancient City Ruins

Sky Fortress

Twilight Dungeon

Dungeon Ownership Buffs:

Ancient City Ruins
🔹 +3% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside ruins

Sky Fortress
🔹 +4% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside fortress

Twilight Underground City
🔹 +5% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside city

Raid Rules:

🔹 Only guilds can register for raids (alliances do not count)
🔹 Raid duration: 1 hour
🔹 Period: Mon 00:00 ~ Sat 24:00
🔹 Ownership transfer: Sun 23:50
🔹 Dungeon ownership is automatically transferred based on raid results (no sieges)
🔹 The owning guild may defend their dungeon through raids
🔹 Only 1 raid attempt per day is allowed (counted from the start)
🔹 Abandoning a dungeon blocks raids until 24:00 of the same day
🔹 Buffs are now retained after death inside dungeons
🔹 Raid applications can be canceled during the week (if not yet completed)
🔹 If a guild abandons a dungeon, they cannot apply or form a raid group for 24 hours (previously 7 days)
🔹 Raid objective changed: now all monsters must be killed

Alliances:

🔹 Added alliance management commands:
  /gacreate [name] — create an alliance (guild leader only)
  /gainvite [guild] — invite a guild (alliance leader only)
  /gakick [guild] — expel a guild (alliance leader only)
  /gadestroy — disband the alliance (alliance leader only)
  /galeave — leave the alliance (if the leader leaves, the alliance disbands)

We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: Rappelz Sports Festival!
notes.content:
We're announcing a “Sports Festival” in Rappelz! Warm up your fingers, stock up your keyboards and go for the win!
 
During the event there is a chance to get the “Festive Sports Chest” for defeating monsters. This box contains a lot of cool items:
⭐ A box of battle arena crystals
⭐ A box of battle arena potions
⭐ A bottle of Fairy Goddess.
⭐ Sweet Bread
⭐ Sweet Water
⭐ A powerful scroll for taming a creature
⭐ Blessing of the Maiden
⭐Medium stone of physical strength: one-handed weapon (x5)
⭐Medium stone of magic power: one-handed weapon (x5)
⭐Medium Stone of Physical Strength: Two-handed Weapon (x5)
⭐Medium stone of magic power: two-handed weapon (x5)
⭐ Book of creature resurrection
⭐ Empty potion bottle, level 2
⭐ Stamina Stabilizer
⭐ Stamina Cookie
⭐ Potion of Luck
⭐ Altered Power Pieces(2)
⭐ Purified Power Pieces(2)
⭐ Gold Energy(2)
⭐ Blessing of the Maiden gr. 2
⭐ Blessed Power of Change: Armor
⭐ Blessed power of change: artifact
⭐ Blessed Power of Change: Medal
⭐Attacking Moon Element 20h.
⭐Number box.

The next competition is for the most experienced players. Time to compete to level up! All characters created after the launch of the event can participate in this competition. The top 10 characters who get the highest level during the event will receive tasty gifts for their efforts:
 
⭐1-3 places: Power of Lusiad Weapon / Armor (32 pcs) or Power of Lusiad Medal (8 pcs) or [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc), [Collection] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc).
⭐4-6 places: Power of Lusiad Weapon/Bronze (16 pieces) or Power of Lusiad Medal (4 pieces) or [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (2 pieces).
⭐7-10 places: Power of Lusiad Weapon/Bronze (8 pieces) or Power of Lusiad Medal (2 pieces) or [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (1 piece).
 
To make leveling up easier, any character created during this event will receive an Experience Potion for 2 hours every time they log in for the duration of the event.
 
And that's not all, it's time to take part in storming the citadel. Convene your guild and shake old times. Guilds participating in this event will receive the appropriate rank and a reward at the end of the event in the form of an extra experience buff valid for 60 days!
 
⭐1-3 places: +20% Experience
⭐4-6 places: +10% Experience
⭐7-10 places: +5% Experience
 
Don't forget to compete in the Boss Battle. For defeating bosses in different dungeons, you will receive “Sportfest Taming Coins”. For reaching a certain number of coins, you will be able to get the following rewards:
⭐10 coins: 5 Fairy Goddess Bottle.
⭐25 coins: Moon Element Attacker 2 pieces.
⭐50 Coins: Superior Experience Potion 2 pieces.
⭐100 coins: Fairy Goddess Bottle 10 pieces.
⭐150 Coins: Moon Attack Element 4 pieces.
⭐200 Coins: Excellent Experience Potion 4 pieces.
⭐250 Coins: Fairy Goddess Bottle 20 pcs.
⭐500 coins: Moon Attack Element 6 pieces.
⭐750 Coins: Excellent Experience Potion 6 pieces.
⭐1000 coins: Pass to Hidden Village 7 days 2 pieces.
⭐1500 Coins: Fairy Goddess Bottle 40 pieces.
⭐2000 coins: Attacking Moon Element 10 pieces.
⭐5000 coins: Superior Experience Potion 10 pieces.
⭐10000 coins: Sports Festival Bosses Cloak 1 piece.

At the end of the event, the top 10 players with the most coins will receive a bonus reward!
 
⭐1-3 places: [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc), [Collection] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc).
⭐4-6 places: [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (2 pcs).
⭐7-10 places: [Boss Map] Phoenix of Chaos (1 piece).
 
List of dungeons from which you can obtain “Coins of Taming Sportsfest”:
⭐Cubarch's Dungeon
⭐ Mine
⭐Circus
⭐ Distorted World
⭐ Island of the Forgotten Gods
⭐ Ruins of an ancient city
⭐ Forgotten ruins of an ancient city
⭐ A cursed temple
⭐ Heavenly fortress
⭐ The twilight underworld.

The next entertainment of our festival is Taming. What's a celebration without faithful companions! For successfully taming a pet of 3 dash or higher, you will receive “Taming Sports Festival Coins”. Like the Boss Battle event, the reward is given for reaching a certain number of coins.
⭐10 coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 5 pieces.
⭐50 coins: Special Soul Unifier 5 pieces.
⭐100 coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 5 pieces.
⭐250 Coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 10 pieces.
⭐500 coins: Special Soul Unifier 10 pieces.
⭐750 Coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 10 pieces.
⭐1000 Coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 20 pieces.
⭐2500 coins: Special Soul Unifier 20 pieces.
⭐5000 coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 20 pieces.
⭐7500 Coins: Powerful creature taming scroll 50 pieces.
⭐10000 coins: Taming Cloak of Sporting Feast 1 piece.

At the end of the event, the top 10 players with the most Taming Coins will receive a bonus reward!

⭐1-3 places: Mirror Card (50 pieces) , Blessed Soul Creator (100 pieces)
⭐4-6 places: Mirror Card (25 pieces) , Blessed Soul Creator (50 pieces)
⭐7-10 places: Mirror Map (10 pieces) , Blessed Soul Creator (20 pieces).
 
Characteristics of the cloaks that can be obtained for the festival: +5% HP/MP/Phys. Atk./M. Atk. and +20 Speed. attack.
 
The festival will last until September 8 (inclusive).
 
We wish you an enjoyable game! ⭐

notes.title: Unification of Panther-Marduk and Haeron servers!
notes.content:
🎮 Dear players!

Today, the server merge has taken place! The game is now even more dynamic, and battles and skirmishes will become even more exciting! Players from the “Pantera-Marduk” and “Haeron” servers will now play together in a shared world — which means new allies and new rivals await you!

🛡 The “Pantera-Marduk” and “Haeron” servers have been merged into one: “Pantera-Haeron” (PvP).
✨ All characters, inventories, and everything related to the character have been successfully transferred.
✨ After the merge, up to 8 of your most recently accessed characters will be available. If you don’t see the ones you need, delete unused characters and use the standard Rappelz character recovery procedure (available for any reason). Recovery is open to all players, including non-GameXP Club members, until July 21 inclusive.
✨ Quick access bars have been cleared — you will need to reassign your skills and items manually.
✨ If characters from the merged servers had the same name, both were given suffixes. A Name Change Ticket will appear in the "Gifts" section of the in-game shop soon, allowing you to rename your character.
✨ In the case of duplicate guild names, the name will remain with the guild that had more members. The smaller guild will receive a suffix. To change the name, please contact support.

notes.title: The Clash of Towns event has begun!
notes.content:
🔥The Clash of Towns event has begun in the world of Rappelz!🔥
 
When you first enter the game, your character automatically falls into one of three teams: Laxey, Horizon or Katana.
 
Near Laxey, Horizon, Katana and Rondo, bosses with the names “Team Laxey”, “Team Horizon” and so on begin to appear.
If a team kills their own boss, they get 10 points.
If a team kills another team's boss, they receive 10% of that team's total score.

For example: Team Laxy kills the boss in Horizon. Team Horizon loses 10% of their points. Before the boss is killed they have 80 points, after the boss is killed by Laxy's team they have 72 points.
 
Respawn time for bosses in Laxey, Horizon and Katana is 1 hour. The boss that spawns in Rondo has a respawn time of 3 hours. Killing this boss gives the team 50 points.
 
When a team kills a boss, a world buff is applied to them for 5 minutes. While it's active, you can meet with your team's NPCs and receive a reward (one randomized enhanced transformation potion that lasts 30 minutes and gives an increase of 5% to damage; the transformation is removed by double-clicking on the buff).
 
When a character receives a reward, the buff is removed from him.
 
At the end of the event, teams receive rewards according to their rating.
 
The first place team receives:
🔹200 Fire Energy
🔹200 Water Energy
🔹200 Wind Energy
🔹5 wings

Second place:
🔹120 Fire Energies
🔹120 Water Energies
🔹120 Wind Energy
🔹2 wings

Third place:
🔹70 Fire Energies
🔹70 Water Energies
🔹70 Wind Energy
🔹1 wings

The player chooses the wings himself, depending on the class and preferences in appearance. The wings are temporary.
 
The event will end on July 7. You will be able to collect rewards from NPCs before the maintenance on July 14.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On May 18 from 9:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. (MSC), the Killer Hour will take place!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: Boss hunt
notes.content:
Residents of Rappelz!

It's time to explore all the hidden corners of Guy's world. Some of them may not have had any characters set foot in them, but that's about to change! After all, this is where the person you are looking for can hide!

48 different types of monsters (2 types of each boss) of 150-200 levels will appear in various territories, with the exception of the Training Island and dungeons. Your task is to find them in time and kill them. After the death of a monster, the player who dealt it the final blow receives one of the special rewards in random amounts:
Battle Arena Crystal Crate
Battle Arena Potions Box
Sweet bread
sweet water
A card with a random buff spell
Endurance Stabilizer
Endurance Cookie
Fairy goddess bottle
Mighty Scroll of Taming Creature
Giant's Nail
Potion of Luck
Creature Resurrection Book
Event Dark Cube
Red Creature Potion
Empty potion bottle
Altered Particles of Power
Refined Motes of Power
The energy of gold
Blessing of the Virgin
Blessed Power of Change: Armor
Attack element of the moon
Box with numbers
Protection powder
Recovery Powder

Monsters have different difficulty levels, and the more difficult the monster (depending on the level and characteristics), the greater the chance of getting an additional reward for it (2 items from the list instead of one).
The resurrection time of monsters is 1 minute, but remember that they can resurrect in a completely different place!

And the most important thing! After the end of the event, the player of each server who has killed the most event bosses will receive a special reward from us - a pass to the Hidden Village for 90 days!

Good luck!

notes.title: The Clash of Towns event has begun!
notes.content:
🔥The Clash of Towns event has begun in the world of Rappelz!🔥
 
When you first enter the game, your character automatically falls into one of three teams: Laxey, Horizon or Katana.
 
Near Laxey, Horizon, Katana and Rondo, bosses with the names “Team Laxey”, “Team Horizon” and so on begin to appear.
If a team kills their own boss, they get 10 points.
If a team kills another team's boss, they receive 10% of that team's total score.

For example: Team Laxy kills the boss in Horizon. Team Horizon loses 10% of their points. Before the boss is killed they have 80 points, after the boss is killed by Laxy's team they have 72 points.
 
Respawn time for bosses in Laxey, Horizon and Katana is 1 hour. The boss that spawns in Rondo has a respawn time of 3 hours. Killing this boss gives the team 50 points.
 
When a team kills a boss, a world buff is applied to them for 5 minutes. While it's active, you can meet with your team's NPCs and receive a reward (one randomized enhanced transformation potion that lasts 30 minutes and gives an increase of 5% to damage; the transformation is removed by double-clicking on the buff).
 
When a character receives a reward, the buff is removed from him.
 
At the end of the event, teams receive rewards according to their rating.
 
The first place team receives:
🔹200 Fire Energy
🔹200 Water Energy
🔹200 Wind Energy
🔹5 wings

Second place:
🔹120 Fire Energies
🔹120 Water Energies
🔹120 Wind Energy
🔹2 wings

Third place:
🔹70 Fire Energies
🔹70 Water Energies
🔹70 Wind Energy
🔹1 wings

The player chooses the wings himself, depending on the class and preferences in appearance. The wings are temporary.
 
The event ends on April 28. You will be able to pick up rewards from the NPC before maintenance works on May 5.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Epic 9.10. King of Alcatraz
notes.content:
The global update is already live! Meet Epic 9.10, "King of Alcatraz," along with all the exciting changes it brings!

NEW QUESTS

Create the Carousel
A new quest chain awaits you, connected to the highly anticipated update. Find the character "Head of Security Kadan" and accept the first quest in the chain: "Defenders' Tension." Note that the character must be level 228 or higher.

The quest chain consists of the following quests:

⭐ Defenders' Tension (Head of Security Kadan)
⭐ Threat to the Kingdom of Gaya (Head of Security Kadan)
⭐ A Request for Help (Mayor Rondo)
⭐ Mercenary Recruitment (1) (Officer of the Resha Guild)
⭐ Mercenary Recruitment (2) (Officer of the Ophelia Guild)
⭐ Mercenary Recruitment (3) (Officer of the Leviathan Guild)
⭐ Good News (Officer of the Ces Guild)
⭐ Delivery to Alcatraz (Head of Security Kadan)
⭐ Clearing the Way (1) (Mage Kael)
⭐ Clearing the Way (2) (Mage Kael)
⭐ Vulcan's Right Hand (Mage Kael)
⭐ Vulcan's Fate (Mage Kael)

New daily/weekly quests have also been added for players level 230 and above. These will be explained in detail by the character Mage Kael in the Marduk Watchtower. By completing these quests, you will receive not only experience and OAs but also useful items like Mithril Ore, Shard of Necron’s Shadow, Alembic Flask of Saragorn, and Bloodied Fang of Karmos.

Weekly and daily quests have also been added for players level 160 and above:
⭐ [Daily] Clearing the Ancient Ruins (Defender Harvey)
⭐ [Daily] Clearing the Ancient Ruins (2) (Defender Harvey)

A weekly quest has been added for players level 180 and above:
⭐ [Weekly] Urgent Request from Naz (Mysterious Old Man Naz)

Weekly quests have been added to the Sky Fortress for players level 190, 200, and 210:
⭐ [Weekly] Sky Fortress Clearing
⭐ [Weekly] Sky Fortress Clearing (2)
⭐ [Weekly] Sky Fortress Clearing (3)

For players level 210 and above, the following quests have been added:
⭐ [Daily] Fight the Guardians (Temple Guardian Oui)
⭐ [Weekly] Escape from the Labyrinth (Temple Guardian Oui)

Quests for players level 220 and above:
⭐ [Daily] General Maan’s Request (1) (General Kalstein Maan)
⭐ [Daily] General Maan’s Request (2) (General Kalstein Maan)
⭐ [Daily] Amir’s Death Squad Request (Commander of Amir’s Death Squad)
⭐ [Weekly] Get Rid of Timru Soldiers (Kalstein Head Liwen)
⭐ [Weekly] Get Rid of Drago Soldiers (Kalstein Head Liwen)
⭐ [Weekly] Destroy the Chaos Race (Kalstein Head Liwen)

NEW DUNGEON

The main new feature is a new dungeon. Access to it will open only after completing the quest "Delivery to Alcatraz." To get the quest, find the character "Head of Security Kadan" in Rondo. Note that the quest is available from level 230.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/06cb558062924510b9e3ed6aab8decc47de4947a.jpg[/img]

When your character reaches level 230, head to the Marduk Watchtower and find Mage Kael. He will help you access the new dungeon. Before entering, you can choose the difficulty level and the maximum number of players (up to 8 players). If the group limit is 2 players and a third player enters, they will automatically be teleported out of the dungeon.

Additional rewards for completion:

Low Difficulty:
⭐ Mithril Ore
⭐ Mithril Bar

High Difficulty:
⭐ Mithril Ore
⭐ Mithril Bar
⭐ Mithril Shadow Ring
⭐ Mithril Bloodthirst Earrings
⭐ Mithril Necklace of Corruption

Additionally, monsters in the dungeon may drop the following items:
⭐ [Boss Card] Bloodthirsty Beast, Karmos (drops from the Bloodthirsty Beast Karmos boss)
⭐ [Boss Card] Dark Alchemist, Saragorn (drops from the Dark Alchemist Saragorn boss)
⭐ [Boss Card] Reaper’s Shadow, Necron (drops from the Reaper’s Shadow Necron boss)
⭐ [Boss Card] Butcher Vulcan (drops from the Butcher Vulcan boss)
⭐ Skill Card Box: Master Profession Specialization
⭐ Lusiad Medal
⭐ Bloodied Fang of Karmos
⭐ Alembic Flask of Saragorn
⭐ Shard of Necron’s Shadow
⭐ Magic Cube
⭐ Spark of Vulcan’s Soul
⭐ Vulcan’s Spark

The higher the difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining valuable items!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/a6ac8a4593cc93088d0796319f8d1d08faffeaff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/9ffbf323be3493186911fd6a167889e84a62ec66.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/c06887db3cddb321917f3903ec2901e3ed44b157.jpg[/img]

NEW BOSS CARDS

[Boss Card] Reaper’s Shadow, Necron
⭐ Incoming damage increased by 5%

[Boss Card] Dark Alchemist, Saragorn
⭐ Physical/Magical Attack +10%
⭐ Luck +30
⭐ Max HP/ Max MP -50%
⭐ Your attacks have a chance to temporarily increase the item drop rate

[Boss Card] Bloodthirsty Beast, Karmos
⭐ Energy +10%
⭐ Max HP +20%
⭐ Strength/Intellect -15%
⭐ Physical/Magical Attack -10%
⭐ Attacks have a certain chance to apply the Devil’s Recovery effect

[Boss Card] Butcher Vulcan
⭐ Penetrating Physical/Magical Damage +20%
⭐ Critical Strike Strength +110
⭐ Incoming damage increased by 5%

Collections:

Reaper’s Shadow, Necron
⭐ Strength/Intellect +50

Dark Alchemist, Saragorn
⭐ Critical Hit Chance +10%
⭐ Physical Attack/Magical Attack +450

Bloodthirsty Beast, Karmos
⭐ Energy +50
⭐ Max HP +2000

Butcher Vulcan
⭐ Penetrating Physical/Magical Damage +500
⭐ Critical Strike Strength +30

CREATURE TRANSFORMATION

Now, you have the ability to create an Eternal Transformation Potion that can be used on your pet.

To create the potion, you need to combine (enchant) any creature of yours that is upgraded to +5 with the corresponding aura for its type. For example, when combining the Hector-Angel creature, you need to select the Mortal Aura.

The chance of transforming the creature is 50%. In case of failure, the creature is destroyed. To avoid destruction, you can use the "Creature Protection" item, which will be available for purchase in the in-game store. This protection will even activate in the case of a successful transformation. After the first use, the item will be “Blocked” (bound to the character).

Transformation can only be applied to your own creature. To activate it, simply select the creature and double-click the transformation potion. After that, the creature will receive a 1-hour buff that changes its appearance. The buff also increases the creature's physical and magical attack by 5%.

Auras drop from monsters whose type matches the aura:
⭐ Beast Aura
⭐ Aina Aura
⭐ Spirit Aura
⭐ Angel Aura
⭐ Devil Aura
⭐ Mecha Aura
⭐ Dragon Aura
⭐ Undead Aura
⭐ Mortal Aura

The chance of obtaining an aura is quite low, so be patient.

ACCESSORY CREATION
New accessories can be obtained by completing the Alcatraz Dungeon or by crafting them yourself. All accessories require a minimum level of 230 to use.

⭐ To craft a Mithril Ring of Shadows, you will need Necron's Shadow Shard (x1) and Mithril Ore (x50).
⭐ Mithril Earrings of Bloodthirst can be crafted using Carmos’ Bloodstained Fang (x1) and Mithril Ore (x50).
⭐ The Mithril Necklace of Corruption is created using Saragorn’s Alembic Flask (x1) and Mithril Ore (x50).
⭐ The Mithril Stone of Chaos can be obtained by combining Volcano's Soul Spark with Mithril Ore (x50).

ACCESSORY ENCHANTMENT
The new accessories use the same enchantment method as Celestial Accessories.

All crafted accessories initially belong to Tier 1 (T1). To upgrade them to Tier 2 (T2), you must first enhance the item to +10. Tier 2 accessories can be further enchanted up to +15.

For enchantment, use Attribute Essence.

ACCESSORY ATTRIBUTES
Rings, earrings, and necklaces can be identified using a Philosopher’s Scroll, as usual.

Each accessory has both base and random attributes. To improve the random attributes, you must enchant the identified accessory using a Purified Mithril Ingot.

Players can re-roll random attributes an unlimited number of times using the Cube of Changes (Reforging Cube / Reroll Cube). Ingots and Cubes can be obtained from Blacksmith Elara in exchange for Mithril Ingots.

(Mithril Ingots can be obtained from Alcatraz monsters or by melting down one of the new accessories.)

TRANSFER FROM ACCESSORIES WITH HEAVENLY SAPPHIRE (Epic 9.7)

A new feature is now available — transferring accessories with Heavenly Sapphire to Mithril accessories! This allows you to upgrade your accessories while keeping important enhancements and awakenings.

How it works: To transfer an accessory with a Heavenly Sapphire to a Mithril one, you will need a new item from the shop — the Sapphire Transfer Scroll. The scroll can be used with the Blacksmith Elara, who is located near the dungeon. The blacksmith has a new option called "Sapphire Transfer."

What is required for the transfer:

The accessory with the Heavenly Sapphire that you want to transfer must be worn by your character (e.g., the Ring with Heavenly Sapphire).
Your inventory must contain the following materials for crafting a Mithril accessory:
x1 Sapphire Transfer Scroll
x50 Mithril Ore
x1 Shard of Necron's Shadow
After this, the NPC will change your Ring with Heavenly Sapphire to a Mithril Ring of Shadows. All enhancements and enchantments will be preserved; however, the random stats will be reset and aligned with the Mithril accessories.

Note: Users who decide to carry out this transfer will avoid the need to re-awaken the accessory. This will save the cost of buying awakening stones for the re-awakening process.

Transferring from accessories with Heavenly Sapphire to Mithril is a convenient way to upgrade your gear without losing progress!

You can find the class rebalance details in the news article at the following link: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1342630/view/536597286667419737.

notes.title: Epic 9.10. King of Alcatraz. ACCESSORY
notes.content:
The Second Part of the Testing Diaries is Here!
In this part, we will talk about the new Rank 8 accessories, which have the ability to enhance random attributes!

ACCESSORY CREATION
New accessories can be obtained by completing the Alcatraz Dungeon or by crafting them yourself. All accessories require a minimum level of 230 to use.

⭐ To craft a Mithril Ring of Shadows, you will need Necron's Shadow Shard (x1) and Mithril Ore (x50).
⭐ Mithril Earrings of Bloodthirst can be crafted using Carmos’ Bloodstained Fang (x1) and Mithril Ore (x50).
⭐ The Mithril Necklace of Corruption is created using Saragorn’s Alembic Flask (x1) and Mithril Ore (x50).
⭐ The Mithril Stone of Chaos can be obtained by combining Volcano's Soul Spark with Mithril Ore (x50).

ACCESSORY ENCHANTMENT
The new accessories use the same enchantment method as Celestial Accessories.

All crafted accessories initially belong to Tier 1 (T1). To upgrade them to Tier 2 (T2), you must first enhance the item to +10. Tier 2 accessories can be further enchanted up to +15.

For enchantment, use Attribute Essence.

ACCESSORY ATTRIBUTES
Rings, earrings, and necklaces can be identified using a Philosopher’s Scroll, as usual.

Each accessory has both base and random attributes. To improve the random attributes, you must enchant the identified accessory using a Purified Mithril Ingot.

Players can re-roll random attributes an unlimited number of times using the Cube of Changes (Reforging Cube / Reroll Cube). Ingots and Cubes can be obtained from Blacksmith Elara in exchange for Mithril Ingots.

(Mithril Ingots can be obtained from Alcatraz monsters or by melting down one of the new accessories.)

⭐ When attacking with magic, Magic Attack increases. Stacks up to 10 times (+0.5% Mag. Atk per stack, max 5%).
⭐ +4 Beast Handling.
⭐ When gaining a certain amount of EXP, for 60 seconds, increases Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Energy, Agility, Wisdom, and Luck by 15 (Stacks 3 times).
⭐ +3 Taming Creatures.
⭐ When receiving damage, there is a chance to increase HP by 0.1% for 600 seconds (Stacks up to 100 times).

How it works: To transfer an accessory with a Heavenly Sapphire to a Mithril one, you will need a new item from the shop — the Sapphire Transfer Scroll. The scroll can be used with the Blacksmith Elara, who is located near the dungeon. The blacksmith has a new option called "Sapphire Transfer."

What is required for the transfer:

The accessory with the Heavenly Sapphire that you want to transfer must be worn by your character (e.g., the Ring with Heavenly Sapphire).
Your inventory must contain the following materials for crafting a Mithril accessory:
x1 Sapphire Transfer Scroll
x50 Mithril Ore
x1 Shard of Necron's Shadow
After this, the NPC will change your Ring with Heavenly Sapphire to a Mithril Ring of Shadows. All enhancements and enchantments will be preserved; however, the random stats will be reset and aligned with the Mithril accessories.

Note: Users who decide to carry out this transfer will avoid the need to re-awaken the accessory. This will save the cost of buying awakening stones for the re-awakening process.

Transferring from accessories with Heavenly Sapphire to Mithril is a convenient way to upgrade your gear without losing progress!

This concludes our diary on the new Epic 9.10 accessories. But exciting news awaits you in the upcoming update!

notes.title: Epic 9.10. King of Alcatraz. New quests, dungeon, creature transformation.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/248dac67970fc587d19ab7ea2c05840153ff6c11.png[/img]

New Epic 9.10. The King of Alcatraz is already on the test server!

This means it’s time to share what awaits us in the near future! Get comfortable — this is the first part of the testing diaries.

NEW QUESTS

Create the Carousel
A new quest chain awaits you, connected to the highly anticipated update. Find the character "Head of Security Kadan" and accept the first quest in the chain: "Defenders' Tension." Note that the character must be level 228 or higher.

The quest chain consists of the following quests:

⭐ Defenders' Tension (Head of Security Kadan)
⭐ Threat to the Kingdom of Gaya (Head of Security Kadan)
⭐ A Request for Help (Mayor Rondo)
⭐ Mercenary Recruitment (1) (Officer of the Resha Guild)
⭐ Mercenary Recruitment (2) (Officer of the Ophelia Guild)
⭐ Mercenary Recruitment (3) (Officer of the Leviathan Guild)
⭐ Good News (Officer of the Ces Guild)
⭐ Delivery to Alcatraz (Head of Security Kadan)
⭐ Clearing the Way (1) (Mage Kael)
⭐ Clearing the Way (2) (Mage Kael)
⭐ Vulcan's Right Hand (Mage Kael)
⭐ Vulcan's Fate (Mage Kael)

New daily/weekly quests have also been added for players level 230 and above. These will be explained in detail by the character Mage Kael in the Marduk Watchtower. By completing these quests, you will receive not only experience and OAs but also useful items like Mithril Ore, Shard of Necron’s Shadow, Alembic Flask of Saragorn, and Bloodied Fang of Karmos.

Weekly and daily quests have also been added for players level 160 and above:
⭐ [Daily] Clearing the Ancient Ruins (Defender Harvey)
⭐ [Daily] Clearing the Ancient Ruins (2) (Defender Harvey)

A weekly quest has been added for players level 180 and above:
⭐ [Weekly] Urgent Request from Naz (Mysterious Old Man Naz)

Weekly quests have been added to the Sky Fortress for players level 190, 200, and 210:
⭐ [Weekly] Sky Fortress Clearing
⭐ [Weekly] Sky Fortress Clearing (2)
⭐ [Weekly] Sky Fortress Clearing (3)

For players level 210 and above, the following quests have been added:
⭐ [Daily] Fight the Guardians (Temple Guardian Oui)
⭐ [Weekly] Escape from the Labyrinth (Temple Guardian Oui)

Quests for players level 220 and above:
⭐ [Daily] General Maan’s Request (1) (General Kalstein Maan)
⭐ [Daily] General Maan’s Request (2) (General Kalstein Maan)
⭐ [Daily] Amir’s Death Squad Request (Commander of Amir’s Death Squad)
⭐ [Weekly] Get Rid of Timru Soldiers (Kalstein Head Liwen)
⭐ [Weekly] Get Rid of Drago Soldiers (Kalstein Head Liwen)
⭐ [Weekly] Destroy the Chaos Race (Kalstein Head Liwen)

NEW DUNGEON

The main new feature is a new dungeon. Access to it will open only after completing the quest "Delivery to Alcatraz." To get the quest, find the character "Head of Security Kadan" in Rondo. Note that the quest is available from level 230.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/06cb558062924510b9e3ed6aab8decc47de4947a.jpg[/img]

When your character reaches level 230, head to the Marduk Watchtower and find Mage Kael. He will help you access the new dungeon. Before entering, you can choose the difficulty level and the maximum number of players (up to 8 players). If the group limit is 2 players and a third player enters, they will automatically be teleported out of the dungeon.

Additional rewards for completion:

Low Difficulty:
⭐ Mithril Ore
⭐ Mithril Bar

High Difficulty:
⭐ Mithril Ore
⭐ Mithril Bar
⭐ Mithril Shadow Ring
⭐ Mithril Bloodthirst Earrings
⭐ Mithril Necklace of Corruption

We will tell you more about the new jewelry in the upcoming diaries.

Additionally, monsters in the dungeon may drop the following items:
⭐ [Boss Card] Bloodthirsty Beast, Karmos (drops from the Bloodthirsty Beast Karmos boss)
⭐ [Boss Card] Dark Alchemist, Saragorn (drops from the Dark Alchemist Saragorn boss)
⭐ [Boss Card] Reaper’s Shadow, Necron (drops from the Reaper’s Shadow Necron boss)
⭐ [Boss Card] Butcher Vulcan (drops from the Butcher Vulcan boss)
⭐ Skill Card Box: Master Profession Specialization
⭐ Lusiad Medal
⭐ Bloodied Fang of Karmos
⭐ Alembic Flask of Saragorn
⭐ Shard of Necron’s Shadow
⭐ Magic Cube
⭐ Spark of Vulcan’s Soul
⭐ Vulcan’s Spark

The higher the difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining valuable items!

NEW BOSS CARDS

[Boss Card] Reaper’s Shadow, Necron
⭐ Incoming damage increased by 5%

[Boss Card] Dark Alchemist, Saragorn
⭐ Physical/Magical Attack +10%
⭐ Luck +30
⭐ Max HP/ Max MP -50%
⭐ Your attacks have a chance to temporarily increase the item drop rate

[Boss Card] Bloodthirsty Beast, Karmos
⭐ Energy +10%
⭐ Max HP +20%
⭐ Strength/Intellect -15%
⭐ Physical/Magical Attack -10%
⭐ Attacks have a certain chance to apply the Devil’s Recovery effect

[Boss Card] Butcher Vulcan
⭐ Penetrating Physical/Magical Damage +20%
⭐ Critical Strike Strength +110
⭐ Incoming damage increased by 5%

Collections:

Reaper’s Shadow, Necron
⭐ Strength/Intellect +50

Dark Alchemist, Saragorn
⭐ Critical Hit Chance +10%
⭐ Physical Attack/Magical Attack +450

Bloodthirsty Beast, Karmos
⭐ Energy +50
⭐ Max HP +2000

Butcher Vulcan
⭐ Penetrating Physical/Magical Damage +500
⭐ Critical Strike Strength +30

CREATURE TRANSFORMATION

Now, you have the ability to create an Eternal Transformation Potion that can be used on your pet.

To create the potion, you need to combine (enchant) any creature of yours that is upgraded to +5 with the corresponding aura for its type. For example, when combining the Hector-Angel creature, you need to select the Mortal Aura.

The chance of transforming the creature is 50%. In case of failure, the creature is destroyed. To avoid destruction, you can use the "Creature Protection" item, which will be available for purchase in the in-game store. This protection will even activate in the case of a successful transformation. After the first use, the item will be “Blocked” (bound to the character).

Transformation can only be applied to your own creature. To activate it, simply select the creature and double-click the transformation potion. After that, the creature will receive a 1-hour buff that changes its appearance. The buff also increases the creature's physical and magical attack by 5%.

Auras drop from monsters whose type matches the aura:
⭐ Beast Aura

⭐ Spirit Aura
⭐ Angel Aura
⭐ Devil Aura
⭐ Mecha Aura
⭐ Dragon Aura
⭐ Undead Aura
⭐ Mortal Aura

The chance of obtaining an aura is quite low, so be patient.

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Amid the hustle and bustle of the closing year and the magic of winter days, the entire GameXP team wishes you a Happy New Year! May your homes be filled with warmth, comfort, and joy, and may harmony, victories, and inspiration reign in your worlds—both real and virtual.

We are grateful to you for being with us this year, exploring new worlds, fighting shoulder to shoulder, and creating incredible stories together. We sincerely believe that the upcoming year will bring you even more exciting adventures, great achievements, and unexpected discoveries.

May the festive lights illuminate your paths like magical orbs, and kind words and gifts warm you like healing potions. May every step on your journey lead to success and joy, and may loyal allies always be by your side!

Our team is also taking a short break to return on January 9 with renewed energy and fresh ideas. However, even during the holidays, our technical support team will continue to take care of you. Response times during the break may be slightly slower than usual, but we will make sure to assist each of you.

With warmth and best wishes,
Your GameXP Team

notes.title: New Year's Eve Event: Loyalists vs. Rebels!
notes.content:
❄ Oh-oh-oh-oh! ❄
🦌A small accident (Rudolph got his feet tangled up again, what a reindeer) caused Santa Claus' sleigh to collapse right onto New Year's Valley. The elves, who had spent years making toys for obedient children, took advantage of this to organize a riot! With the help of the lost toys, they plan to raise their own army and break their fellow elves out from under the tyranny of Santa Claus. But they'll need help to collect the toys - it's pretty dangerous for these little creatures in New Year's Valley.

The elves, loyal to Santa Claus, are also collecting toys to save New Year's Eve, so the freedom fighters try to get ahead of them.

🎄When you first enter the game, you can automatically join the rebels or the loyalists. Look for the rebel leader in Katana and the loyalist leader in Laxi to move to a special dungeon, New Year's Valley. When hunting monsters in the New Year's Valley, you will be able to get toys to turn in to your team leader.

The choice of valley depends on the level of your character - if you have not yet reached level 150, you can choose the White Valley, which is home to monsters from level 20 to 149. The Red Valley is for characters of level 150 and above. The Black Valley makes sense if your level exceeds 160, and the Obsidian Valley is not worth going to unless you have reached level 180.

The more toys you give up, the more the special effect that increases all characteristics except luck will grow. The effect is applied to you when you enter the game and also affects your creatures.

While the event lasts, on two different days, the winning team will be able to get access to a purified demonic outfit, already sharpened to +24 and valid for 3 days.
But that's not all! In the New Year's Valley not only toys fall from the monsters, but also many useful things: Christmas decorative costumes, stamina stabilizers, bottles of the Fairy Goddess, potions of luck, a pass to the Hidden Village for 7 days, the blessing of the Maiden, the power of change: armor, armor of the conqueror of the Warped World, weapons and jewelry from the Circus and from the Island of Forgotten Gods, shields and jewelry from the Cursed Temple, blank cards of arena pets.

And the best part - from the final boss of the Black and Obsidian New Year's Valley you can get the Perfect Weapon Improvement Transfer Scroll!

The team with the most toys collected will receive a cloak or transformation potions.

Entry to New Year's Valley will close on January 16. Team Leaders will stay with you for another week so you have time to turn in your accumulated toys, and will disappear on January 23.

What are you waiting for? Let's go on a winter adventure!

notes.title: Unification of Panther-Hector and Marduk servers!
notes.content:
Dear players!

Today we have merged the servers. Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, players of the servers “Panther-Hector” and “Marduk” will now play together in one game world, and therefore will find new friends and opponents!

The servers “Panther-Hector” and “Marduk” are united into a single server “Panther-Marduk” (PvP).
✨All characters, inventory, and everything that pertains to a character has been moved with it to the merged server.
✨After the merge, the 8 characters you logged in last are available. If the choice of characters does not suit you, delete the extra ones and use the standard procedure for restoring Rappelz characters / My character was deleted (for any reason). After the merge, the standard Rappelz character recovery procedure is available to all players, including non-GameXP Club members, up to and including January 9.
✨ The quick access panel has been cleared for all characters on the merged servers. To fill it up again, you will need to re-post skills and items to the panel.
✨When matching character names from merged servers, a postscript is added to the names of both characters. They will soon be able to find a Character Name Change Ticket in the Gifts section of the game store, thanks to which they will be able to change their name.
✨If the merged servers had the same guild names, the guild with the highest number of players will retain the name. The guild that had fewer players will see a postscript in the guild name. To change the name, you will need to write to tech support.
✨ The storekeeper only displays 1000 slots. If you do not find items from different servers in your chest after merging, you must pull items into your inventory so that there are less than 1000 items left in the chest and restart the game. If you do not find any items, write to tech support.
✨All items placed before the server merge on the in-game auction remain on the auction. If you do not find them, check the storekeeper.
✨GXP auction lots placed before the server merge will be returned to their owners.
✨ Dungeon ownership has been reset. It is necessary to recapture the dungeon.
We wish you exciting adventures on the merged server!

notes.title: New Year's jackpot!
notes.content:
🎄You have a unique opportunity to take part in the New Year Jackpot!

Jackpot is a great opportunity to get some of the most expensive and useful items at a mind-blowing discount, as well as win GXP!

notes.title: Хэллоуин приходит в Rappelz!
notes.content:
The Halloween event is in full swing! We present you the second part of the event, during which you can get the same useful items as in the first part, as well as holiday costumes!
 
All Saints' Landing Pass has been added to your character's inventory! Contact a member of the Necromancer Guild to travel to this dungeon for one hour. The pass is issued once a day. When moving to the country of all saints, the pass disappears, and a special effect is applied to the character for an hour - while it is there, you can return to the dungeon if for some reason you decide to leave it earlier. After an hour, the characters are automatically moved to the city from the dungeon.
 
The level of the dungeon and the monsters in it depends on the level of the character: one dungeon for 20 - 169 levels and one for characters above level 170.
 
Magic artifacts already known to you fall from monsters:
pumpkin sweets that instantly restore health and mana,
necromancer crystals that increase certain stats by 66,
zombie nail (increases character height for 30 minutes),
creepy stamina stabilizers,
damn stamina cookie,
terrible potion (halloween version of luck potion),
Frankenstein Potion (Halloween version of BBF),
stat-boosting Halloween hats for 365 days,
card of the High Witch,
various charged particles of the Necromancer,
various pure parts of the Necromancer,
decorative Halloween pets for 28 days,
distorted zombie mask,
halloween cape surprise.
And most importantly - only from the monsters of the holiday dungeon you can get special costumes that, when printed, receive special characteristics, and you can open them with the help of a philosophical scroll. The lifetime of such suits is 1 year.
 
Is one dungeon a day not enough?
 
Then you should take a walk to the Necromancer's Cemetery, unless, of course, you are afraid!
To get there, you will need a special pass, which you can purchase from the in-game store. The Necromancer's Graveyard adjusts to your character's level just like the Vulcano Dungeon, and you can spend two hours there with one pass. Here you need to kill monsters to make one of the 4 bosses appear. When there are 10 monsters left, a boss will appear in the lower right corner of the map.
 
If you prefer not to go to dark places, then there is good news for you too - the first part of the event continues! Monsters still drop souls, and you can still exchange them with necromancers for buffs and useful items.
 
The event will end on November 25 during maintenance, and the necromancers will remain in Guy's world for another week, until December 2, so that you can exchange all the collected souls.

notes.title: Halloween is coming to Rappelz!
notes.content:
Did you feel it? Adherents of the necromancer guild recently emerged from the catacombs, bringing with them the smell of decay. Hungry for fresh souls, they will sell you anything to get them, and they will even share their dark power. These exiles may not look powerful enough, but don't underestimate them or you'll be damned forever!

Between October 23 and November 25, kill monsters and collect souls from them. In Horizon, Catana, Laxey, Rondo and in the Dead City you can find Halloween Stewards from the Necromancers Guild.

For 2 monster souls, you can receive a powerful aura from them for 2 hours, giving +66 to all characteristics except luck.

And for 1 soul - magical Halloween artifacts, including:
🎃pumpkin sweets that instantly restore health and mana,
🎃necromancer crystals that increase certain characteristics by 66,
🎃zombie nail (increases character growth for 30 minutes),
🎃terrible stamina stabilizers,
🎃damned stamina cookies,
🎃horrible potion (Halloween version of a good luck potion),
🎃Frankenstein's potion (Halloween version of BBF),
🎃stat-boosting Halloween hats for 365 days,
🎃High Witch card,
🎃various charged particles of the Necromancer,
🎃various pure particles of the Necromancer,
🎃decorative Halloween pets for 28 days,
🎃distorted zombie mask,
🎃Halloween surprise cape.

It is not necessary to exchange all collected souls one at a time - you can exchange 1, 10, 25 or 50 souls at once and receive a reward for each of them.

Upon entering the game, each character will receive a special effect that increases all of their characteristics, except luck, for 2 hours. The more monster souls players on your server turn over to Halloween stewards, the stronger the effect becomes. To update it, simply re-login to your character. Every day the buff is reset to 0.5% and accumulates again.

But that is not all! You will probably notice that adherents of the necromancer guild are talking about some kind of festive costumes. What is it? Follow the news carefully, and very soon you will find out everything!

We wish you a hell of a Halloween!

notes.title: Rappelz Sports Festival!
notes.content:
With the project's birthday just around the corner, we're announcing a “Sports Festival” in Rappelz! Warm up your fingers, stock up your keyboards and go for the win!
 
During the event there is a chance to get the “Festive Sports Chest” for defeating monsters. This box contains a lot of cool items:
⭐ A box of battle arena crystals
⭐ A box of battle arena potions
⭐ A bottle of Fairy Goddess.
⭐ Sweet Bread
⭐ Sweet Water
⭐ A powerful scroll for taming a creature
⭐ Blessing of the Maiden

⭐Medium Stone of Physical Strength: Two-handed Weapon (x5)
⭐Medium stone of magic power: two-handed weapon (x5)
⭐ Book of creature resurrection
⭐ Empty potion bottle, level 2
⭐ Stamina Stabilizer
⭐ Stamina Cookie
⭐ Potion of Luck
⭐ Altered Power Pieces(2)

⭐ Gold Energy(2)

⭐ Blessed Power of Change: Armor
⭐ Blessed power of change: artifact
⭐ Blessed Power of Change: Medal
⭐Attacking Moon Element 20h.
⭐Number box.

The next competition is for the most experienced players. Time to compete to level up! All characters created after the launch of the event can participate in this competition. The top 10 characters who get the highest level during the event will receive tasty gifts for their efforts:
 
⭐1-3 places: Power of Lusiad Weapon / Armor (32 pcs) or Power of Lusiad Medal (8 pcs) or [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc), [Collection] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc).
⭐4-6 places: Power of Lusiad Weapon/Bronze (16 pieces) or Power of Lusiad Medal (4 pieces) or [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (2 pieces).
⭐7-10 places: Power of Lusiad Weapon/Bronze (8 pieces) or Power of Lusiad Medal (2 pieces) or [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (1 piece).
 
To make leveling up easier, any character created during this event will receive an Experience Potion for 2 hours every time they log in for the duration of the event.
 
And that's not all, it's time to take part in storming the citadel. Convene your guild and shake old times. Guilds participating in this event will receive the appropriate rank and a reward at the end of the event in the form of an extra experience buff valid for 60 days!
 
⭐1-3 places: +20% Experience
⭐4-6 places: +10% Experience
⭐7-10 places: +5% Experience
 
Don't forget to compete in the Boss Battle. For defeating bosses in different dungeons, you will receive “Sportfest Taming Coins”. For reaching a certain number of coins, you will be able to get the following rewards:
⭐10 coins: 5 Fairy Goddess Bottle.

⭐10000 coins: Sports Festival Bosses Cloak 1 piece.

At the end of the event, the top 10 players with the most coins will receive a bonus reward!
 
⭐1-3 places: [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc), [Collection] Phoenix of Chaos (1 pc).
⭐4-6 places: [Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos (2 pcs).
⭐7-10 places: [Boss Map] Phoenix of Chaos (1 piece).

notes.title: JACKPOT OF GOLDEN LEAF FALL!
notes.content:
You are given a unique opportunity to take part in the Golden Leaf Fall Jackpot.

🔥What is Jackpot?

Jackpot is a great opportunity to get some of the most expensive and useful products at a mind-blowing discount, and also win GXP!
The final size of the Jackpot is not limited and its current amount is available on the main page of the site!

🔥How is the prize fund formed?

When purchasing each product, a portion of the funds is transferred to the accumulative Jackpot prize fund, which will be drawn among the participants! The amount accumulated during the promotion period will be drawn at the end of the promotion on September 19 between Rappelz players participating in the Jackpot.

🔥How does the award ceremony take place?

A prize of 50% of the accumulated amount will be received by 1 winner, and the remaining 50% will be distributed among the remaining 5 winners.

🔥When will I be able to find out the results and receive my reward?

Jackpot results will be announced within 3 business days after the end of the promotion.

Winning GXP will be credited to winners' accounts within three business days.

You can take part in the jackpot from September 5 to September 18 (inclusive).

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On August 31 from 9:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. (MSC), the Killer Hour will take place!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: 31.07.2024 Game update
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the game:
 
▪ Changes to Grace Skill: The skill has been reset for all characters. The maximum level in the skill tree is now 1. The base duration has been increased from 30 minutes to 45 minutes. The cost of Grace Silvers has been adjusted and the new level requirements are as follows : 1, 8, 12, 16, 20, 32, 48, 72, 104, 156, 232, 348, 520, 780, 1168, 1752, 2628, 3944, 5912.

notes.title: Event Shapito
notes.content:
The Red Spider Circus has no competition. But the newly arrived artists are not timid and have prepared for you performances in all corners of the world of Gaia!

Now from all monsters fall boxes with balloons, from which you have a chance to get one of the colored balloons. By bursting the balloon you can get the following buffs:

🎈Red Balloon: +25% Max. HP/MP
🎈 Blue Balloon: +10% F. Atk/M. Atk
🎈Yellow Balloon: +10% F. Defense/M. Defense.
🎈Green ball: +10% F. Att. Atk / Sk. Zackle
🎈 Black Orb: +5% Crit Power.

Additionally, with a small chance, you may get one of the following items from the balloon:
💎 Blessing of the Maiden Ur. 2
💎 An empty potion bottle, level 2.
💎Attacking Moon Element <1 hour>
💎Mighty creature taming scroll.
💎Sealed Scroll of Awakening: Weapon (7 days).
💎Sealed Awakening Scroll: Accessories (7 days).

But that's not all!
Harlequin and some monkeys have stolen valuable Chests from the Circus. You can find them all over the world of Gaia! (Except the Island of the Forgotten Gods.) After you find a hidden chest, open it and defeat the thieves. You may get a chance to defeat 1 to 5 Thieving Monkeys or one Evil Harlequin (boss).
The boss appears with a certain probability after killing 11 Thieving Monkeys. After the boss appears, your monkey score is reset and the boss can only reappear after defeating 11 opponents again. The maximum number of bosses you can summon per day is 11.

If you kill a Boss more than 10 times in a day, you will not be able to get a reward for it, instead you will get a reward from the Thieving Monkey list.

Possible rewards for killing the Thieving Monkey:
💎 Blessing of the Virgin Ur. 2
💎 An empty potion bottle, level 2.
💎Attacking Moon Elemental <1 hour>
💎Mighty creature taming scroll.
💎Sealed Scroll of Awakening: Weapon (7 days).
💎Sealed Awakening Scroll: Accessories (7 days).

Possible rewards for killing the Evil Harlequin:
💎Shard of Naha's Medal
💎 Blessed Creator of Souls
💎 Lusiad's Growth Potion.
💎 Blessing of the Virgin Ur. 2
💎Empty potion vial from the potion level 2.
💎Attacking Moon Element <1 hour>
💎Mighty creature taming scroll.
💎Sealed Scroll of Awakening: Weapon (7 days).
💎Sealed Awakening Scroll: Accessories (7 days)

Opening a chest containing a Thieving Monkey grants 10 Arena Points.
Opening a chest containing an Evil Harlequin gives 50 Arena Points.

Each day you will be given a 10 Circus Chest Inventory when you enter the game. Using it, you can find out how many chests are still left on the map.
Chests are updated every hour (00:00, 01:00, 02:00...) and you will have 50 minutes to find them until they disappear (00:50, 01:50, 02:50...).

We wish you a good mood and game!

notes.title: The Clash of Towns event has begun!
notes.content:
🔥The Clash of Towns event has begun in the world of Rappelz!🔥
 
When you first enter the game, your character automatically falls into one of three teams: Laxey, Horizon or Katana.
 
Near Laxey, Horizon, Katana and Rondo, bosses with the names “Team Laxey”, “Team Horizon” and so on begin to appear.
If a team kills their own boss, they get 10 points.
If a team kills another team's boss, they receive 10% of that team's total score.

For example: Team Laxy kills the boss in Horizon. Team Horizon loses 10% of their points. Before the boss is killed they have 80 points, after the boss is killed by Laxy's team they have 72 points.
 
Respawn time for bosses in Laxey, Horizon and Katana is 1 hour. The boss that spawns in Rondo has a respawn time of 3 hours. Killing this boss gives the team 50 points.
 
When a team kills a boss, a world buff is applied to them for 5 minutes. While it's active, you can meet with your team's NPCs and receive a reward (one randomized enhanced transformation potion that lasts 30 minutes and gives an increase of 5% to damage; the transformation is removed by double-clicking on the buff).
 
When a character receives a reward, the buff is removed from him.
 
At the end of the event, teams receive rewards according to their rating.
 
The first place team receives:
🔹200 Fire Energy
🔹200 Water Energy
🔹200 Wind Energy
🔹5 wings

Second place:
🔹120 Fire Energies
🔹120 Water Energies
🔹120 Wind Energy
🔹2 wings

Third place:
🔹70 Fire Energies
🔹70 Water Energies
🔹70 Wind Energy
🔹1 wings

The player chooses the wings himself, depending on the class and preferences in appearance. The wings are temporary.
 
The event ends on July 22. You will be able to pick up rewards from the NPC before maintenance works on July 29th.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Merge Panther-Vulcano and Hector servers
notes.content:
Dear players!
 
Today we have merged the servers. Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, players of the servers "Panther-Vulcano" and "Hector" will now play together in one game world, and therefore will find new friends and opponents!
 
The Panther-Vulcano and Hector servers have been merged into a single Panther-Hector (PvP) server.
▪ All characters, inventory, and everything related to a character have been moved with it to the merged server.
▪After the merge, the 8 characters you logged in last are available. If you are not satisfied with the selection of characters, delete the extra characters and use the standard Rappelz / My character was deleted (for any reason) character recovery procedure. After the merge, the standard Rappelz character recovery procedure is available to all players, including non-GameXP Club members, up to and including June 10.
▪The quick access panel has been cleared for all characters on the merged servers. You will need to re-post skills and items to the panel to fill it up again.
▪When character names from the merged servers match, a postscript is added to the names of both characters. They will soon be able to find a Character Name Change Ticket in the Gifts section of the in-game store, thanks to which they will be able to change their name.
▪If there were the same guild names on the merged servers, the name will be retained for the guild with the highest number of players. The guild that had fewer players will see a postscript in the guild name. You will need to write to tech support to change the name.
▪ The storekeeper only displays 1000 slots. If you do not find items from different servers in your chest after merging, you should pull items into your inventory so that there are less than 1000 items left in the chest and restart the game. If you do not find any items, write to tech support.
▪ All items placed before the server merge on the in-game auction remain on the in-game auction. If you do not find them, check the storekeeper.
▪GXP auction lots placed before the server merge will be returned to their owners.
▪ Dungeon ownership has been reset. It is necessary to recapture the dungeon.

We wish you exciting adventures on the merged server!

notes.title: Horizon is in danger!
notes.content:
Want to know how to increase the server buff this weekend and get useful loot?
 
The monsters of Guy's world, who are tired of the constant hunting for them, continue their riot! Templar Guild intelligence reports: the monsters are planning a new attack on the already suspicious Horizon! The smuggler of the Nostra clan managed to overhear their plot again, and this is what he told!
 
The attack will take place this Friday at Horizon Field:
[list]
[*] Hector- 17:30 Moscow time
[*] Panther-Vulcano - 18:00 Moscow time
[*] Angel Minotaur - 18:30 UTC
[/list]

The energy of the dead monsters will increase the server buff this weekend: each killed Reviak will increase the level of the "Necromancer's Power" buff (+0.5% to all characteristics) by 1! And of course, the defenders of the city will be able to get loot from the bosses!
 
Good luck defenders!

notes.title: 03.06.2024 Game update
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the game:
 
▪ Monsters in the Twilight Dungeon are stunned in a new way.

Before: Templar will not be stunned, instead an area healing reduction is applied
After: Templar and Crystal Golem (Evo 3) will not be stunned, instead area healing reduction is applied.

Berserk and Mercenary have an 80% chance to prevent being stunned, in which case the mobs will apply AoE-reduced healing.

Creatures other than Crystal Golem (evolution) are stunned for 7.5 seconds instead of 15 seconds.

▪ Blessed Ability Switch now works on the following gear: Enchanted Warped World gear, Nusilith gear, Flaminius gear, Inferno gear, Reviak gear, and Twilight gear.

▪ The Speed of Light skill now works for all weapons. (Previously only from a two-handed mace).

▪ Changed player buffs in the Hidden Village.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/ed246de16254ba5a98691ec88b7b6a640392e2b3.png[/img]

▪ The Shard of Transformed Awakening can be used on decorative items.

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: Boss hunt
notes.content:
Residents of Rappelz!

It's time to explore all the hidden corners of Guy's world. Some of them may not have had any characters set foot in them, but that's about to change! After all, this is where the person you are looking for can hide!

48 different types of monsters (2 types of each boss) of 150-200 levels will appear in various territories, with the exception of the Training Island and dungeons. Your task is to find them in time and kill them. After the death of a monster, the player who dealt it the final blow receives one of the special rewards in random amounts:
Battle Arena Crystal Crate
Battle Arena Potions Box
Sweet bread
sweet water
A card with a random buff spell
Endurance Stabilizer
Endurance Cookie
Fairy goddess bottle
Mighty Scroll of Taming Creature
Giant's Nail
Potion of Luck
Creature Resurrection Book
Event Dark Cube
Red Creature Potion
Empty potion bottle
Altered Particles of Power
Refined Motes of Power
The energy of gold
Blessing of the Virgin
Blessed Power of Change: Armor
Attack element of the moon
Box with numbers
Protection powder
Recovery Powder

Monsters have different difficulty levels, and the more difficult the monster (depending on the level and characteristics), the greater the chance of getting an additional reward for it (2 items from the list instead of one).
The resurrection time of monsters is 1 minute, but remember that they can resurrect in a completely different place!

And the most important thing! After the end of the event, the player of each server who has killed the most event bosses will receive a special reward from us - a pass to the Hidden Village for 90 days!

Good luck!

notes.title: EGG HUNT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/2cf8d4abac62413749f846221908cec59b8b68b6.png[/img]

From April 22 to May 20, you can get a Faded Eggshell from all the monsters in Guy's World. Take it to the Egg Fairy in any city. She will randomly color your eggshell pale pink, yellow, white, blue, or green.

The resulting pale shell can be used to gain buffs for 1 hour:
▪ pale blue - increases maximum MP by 5%,
▪ pale green - increases maximum HP by 5%,
▪ pale white - increases physical and magical attack by 3%,
▪ pale pink - increases luck by 30,
▪ pale yellow - increases physical and magical defense by 3%.

Another option to use them is to combine 5 identical pale shells to get a corresponding bright egg. The bright egg can be opened to get one of the following items:
▪3 milk chocolate eggs
▪ 3 white chocolate eggs
▪1 dark chocolate egg
▪1 bottle of Fairy Goddess
▪2 boxes of random fragments
▪1 potion of luck
▪1 fire energy
▪1 book of creature resurrection
▪1 blessed creature box

Also with a small chance of:
▪ from blue egg: blessed power of change: artifact,
▪ from green egg: stability card,
▪ from a white egg: a box of random decorative dark mage equipment,
▪ from pink egg: blessed power of change: armor,
▪ from the yellow egg: ancient magic cube.

The lifespan of any shells and eggs is 14 days. Remember to exchange them or use them before this time limit expires.

We wish you good luck in your hunt!

notes.title: The Clash of Towns event has begun!
notes.content:
🔥The Clash of Towns event has begun in the world of Rappelz!🔥
 
When you first enter the game, your character automatically falls into one of three teams: Laxey, Horizon or Katana.
 
Near Laxey, Horizon, Katana and Rondo, bosses with the names “Team Laxey”, “Team Horizon” and so on begin to appear.
If a team kills their own boss, they get 10 points.
If a team kills another team's boss, they receive 10% of that team's total score.

For example: Team Laxy kills the boss in Horizon. Team Horizon loses 10% of their points. Before the boss is killed they have 80 points, after the boss is killed by Laxy's team they have 72 points.
 
Respawn time for bosses in Laxey, Horizon and Katana is 1 hour. The boss that spawns in Rondo has a respawn time of 3 hours. Killing this boss gives the team 50 points.
 
When a team kills a boss, a world buff is applied to them for 5 minutes. While it's active, you can meet with your team's NPCs and receive a reward (one randomized enhanced transformation potion that lasts 30 minutes and gives an increase of 5% to damage; the transformation is removed by double-clicking on the buff).
 
When a character receives a reward, the buff is removed from him.
 
At the end of the event, teams receive rewards according to their rating.
 
The first place team receives:
🔹200 Fire Energy
🔹200 Water Energy
🔹200 Wind Energy
🔹5 wings

Second place:
🔹120 Fire Energies
🔹120 Water Energies
🔹120 Wind Energy
🔹2 wings

Third place:
🔹70 Fire Energies
🔹70 Water Energies
🔹70 Wind Energy
🔹1 wings

The player chooses the wings himself, depending on the class and preferences in appearance. The wings are temporary.
 
The event will end on March 29. You will be able to pick up the rewards from the NPC before maintenance on April 5.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On March 10 from 9:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. (MSC), the Killer Hour will take place!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: EPIC 9.9: TWILIGHT UNDERWORLD: MEDALS, NEW ARMOR, SKILLS FOR OT.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/92ef73fb7ce95b0a1254487665a2f71dc2c5440c.png[/img]

For defeating monsters in the dungeon, you will receive different ingredients to create new armor and medals. Getting the items you want won't be easy, but we know you'll be able to pull it off.

New Armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/255b1bcac9d6ed4bdf81abf2414de0a2ebe9a999.png[/img]

You can get a new set of twilight armor by upgrading a set of Lucis armor. To upgrade the armor you will need Twilight Crystals, which can be obtained by combining items dropped in the dungeon, and Twilight Ore.

For 1 Twilight Crystal, you will need 10 Timru Crystals, 10 Drago Crystals, and 10 Chaos Crystals.

You can get Timru crystals for defeating a Timru boss, Timru soldiers, Timru officer and Timru NOC.

Drago crystals are dropped from Drago soldiers, Drago officers and Drago NOCs.

Chaos Crystals you will get from Chaos Flight, Chaos Nom, Chaos Crowler and Chaos Phoenix.

Twilight Ore drops from all of the above monsters.

Below are the characteristics of the Twilight Armor. Lusiad's power is increased to 40 for the Twilight Armor set.

Set Bonus:
▪+20% Strength, Energy, Dexterity, Agility, Skill, Intelligence, Wisdom
▪+20% Physical Attack/Magic Attack. Attacks
▪+10% Max. XP/MP

Twilight Helmet:
▪+15% Evasion / Magic Resistance
▪+5% Physical Attack/Mag. Attacks.

Twilight Gloves:
▪+30 Attack Speed / Spell Reading Speed
▪+10% Accuracy / Magic Accuracy.

Twilight Boots:
▪+30 movement speed
▪+5% Physical Attack / Mag. Attacks.

Twilight Armor:
▪+25% Strength, Energy, Skill
▪+15% Physical Attack/Magic Attack. Attacks.
▪+10% Evasion

Twilight Armor :
▪+25% Dexterity, Dexterity, Energy
▪+15% Physical Attack / Mag. Attacks.
▪+10% Evasion

Twilight Cloak:
▪+25% Wisdom, Energy, Intelligence
▪+15% Physical Attacks / Magical Attacks. Attacks.
▪+10% Mag. Resistance

Twilight Cloak:
▪+25% Strength, Energy, Intelligence
▪+15% Physical Attack / Mag. Attacks.
▪+5% Evasion / Magic Resistance.

To create a Twilight Helmet, you will need: Lucis Helmet + Nusilith Helmet + Twilight Crystal x500 + Twilight Ore x50.
To create Twilight Gloves you will need: Lucis Gloves + Nusilith Gloves + Twilight Crystal x500 + Twilight Ore x50.
Twilight Boots: Lucis Boots + Nusilith Boots + Twilight Crystal x500 + Twilight Ore x50
Twilight Armor: Lucis Armor + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100
Twilight Armor: Lucis Armor + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100
Twilight Cloak: Lucis' Cloak + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100
Twilight Cloak: Lucis' Cloak + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100

To create twilight armor, you need to put the materials in the enchanting window.
Hint: to put a stack of materials at once, open the combo window first, put all the items you need in there and go back to the enchanting window.

Medals

New medals have been added to the game. You will be able to create a regular medal by using 1000 Simple Naha Blueprints or 500 Naha Blueprints or 100 Improved Naha Blueprints. If your creation attempt fails, you will receive 1 shard of the medal. For 10 shards, you will receive a regular medal.

Blueprints drop from monsters of the Twilight Underworld.
If you have a Naha Medal Shard, you can use it instead of a regular medal shard.

To identify the medal, you need to combine it with the Philosopher's Scroll and the Book of Secrets (sold at the Smuggler for 5 billion rupees) or the Power of Change: Medal and the Book of Secrets. Once identified, medals can be combined with Strength, Intelligence, and Health stones (purchased from the in-game store) to produce an improved medal.

The improved medal can be re-evaluated with the "Blessed Power of Change: medal" from the in-game store. All new improved medals can be sharpened to +20 and then gain +32 Lusiad power.

To sharpen from 0 to +20, you will need a Medal Cube (purchased from the arena item store) or an Ancient Medal Cube (can be created by combining 1 Medal Cube and an Ancient Stone (sold in the in-game store). If the sharpening fails, you can restore the item with Recovery Powder: Medal from the in-game store.

To increase Lusiad's strength to 32, you must use Lusiad's Strength: Medal (extracted from a +20 medal with the Lusiad's Strength Extractor).

Information on medal characteristics can be found below.

Normal Medal: +5% to stats (except luck)
Improved Health Medal: +15% Max. HP / Max. MP, +15% Physical Defense/Magic Defense, +15% HP Recovery.
Improved Strength Medal: +20% Physical Attack, +20 Crit Power.
Improved Intelligence Medal: +20% Magic Attack, +20 Crit Power.

Below you can see the medal sharpening table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/625a70dac657dbce9229abbf71c31f9172eb25a1.png[/img]

Random Skills

Added the ability to get a random skill for talent points.
Now you can get 2 additional new skills for your class when gaining certain profession levels. The chance of getting one is the same for all skills. It is not possible to get a skill for a class you are not currently in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/694ddd2565b0ecd73023c9825e14aecd9d027ce8.png[/img]

For 1 OT, you can gain one of the following skills.

List of random skills (1)*:
▪ Mask of Magic
▪ Predator of Sura
▪ Wild Instinct
▪ Apostle of Darkness
▪ The ultimate terror
▪ Deadly attack
▪ Pure magic
Blessing of Purified Water

Random skill list (2)*:
▪Mystic sword
▪ Fatal Link
▪ Angel's Deception
▪ Magic Swamp
▪ Dissecting the darkness
Mana Aura Crystal
▪ Self-Discipline: Intelligence
Berserk Energy
▪ Smooth Mana Energy
▪ The doom of reckless magic
▪ Mass Magic
▪ The instinct of the sharp beast.

*Note, skill names in game are subject to change.

Other innovations:

▪ Damage over time (poisons, bleeding, etc.) is now factored into damage reduction.
▪Arena for players above level 220 has been added. Level 220+ players can now purchase a Medal Cube from NIPs for arena points.
▪Buffs are now not removed from characters when entering the arena or participating in the "Bloody Battle".
▪The durability of creature cards is now 10 regardless of reinforcement (except +0).
▪ Increased the maximum level from 240 to 250.
▪Pet level increased to 220.

The game update is coming soon. Just a little bit of patience left.
We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: EPIC 9.9: TWILIGHT UNDERWORLD: NEW DUNGEON
notes.content:
Testing of the new Epic has begun, so it's time to tell you the details of the new long-awaited update.
 
In Epic 9.9 a new dungeon "Twilight Underworld" is waiting for you. Only players who have reached level [b]220 and completed the quest "King of Quizzes"[/b] (Epic 9.8 "Labyrinth of Light" quest) will be able to get there. So if you still haven't reached the required numbers, push on, you still have time to catch up with the others and enter the dungeon among the first.
 
All players level 220+ will have a [b]new quest chain[/b] required to enter the dungeon. It all starts with the priest Sirkki in Northwest Katana. You can see the entire quest chain below:
 
Sacred Weapon of the Order of Dusk 2 - Shirky's Letter of Recommendation - Mysterious Request - Murder Request - Change the Course of Events - Contact Mirielle - What do I do now? - Why does he have to die? - He's left alone, it's a great chance. - Kill again? - Change course of events 2 - Drago's Penetration 1 - Drago's Penetration 2 - How long have you been here? - Drago's Family Situation - Guide of the Valley of Flame - Monster of the Valley of Flame - Hero of the Underworld.
 
After completing all quests you will receive 1 OT and access to the Twilight Underworld, the entrance to which is in the southern part of Katana.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/10926e00df6c89b8fdcef9a1f46a510e6195135e.png[/img]

The dungeon consists of three zones, Blue is Timru, Purple is Drago, and Red is Chaos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/9de1e0b402f8b318989e4fecadf84ebfc1fb113a.png[/img]

To get to the boss area of "Phoenix of Chaos" you need to defeat "Nom of Chaos" and "Crowler of Chaos", after which a gate to the boss can open for one minute. The gate has a 20% chance of appearing.
When the gate appears and you enter the platform area, a teleportation pop-up will appear. It is only possible to leave the boss room after defeating the boss, so be careful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/10403198824b7b830e19a8f16a31324ccab63af8.png[/img]

For defeating the Phoenix of Chaos, you have a chance to get new boss cards and combine them into collections!
 
[b][Boss Card] Phoenix of Chaos: Warrior[/b] (Can only be equipped with physical classes)
Card Characteristics:
▪ Strength / Dexterity: +10%
▪ Critical Strength: +30%
▪ Chaos Phoenix Reinforcement: Warrior Effect: Physical Attack: +50% , Attack Speed: +30%, Max. HP: +20%
▪ Chance to absorb 1% HP damage when attacking.
▪ Stops enemy's health regeneration.

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On January 14 from 9:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. (MSC), the Killer Hour will take place!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: CHRISTMAS BUFF!
notes.content:
🎄 From December 25 until January 22, there will be a Christmas buff for all players!

Every day you will be able to get a free buff from the event NIP, which will be valid for 6 hours. If you don't like the received buff, you can change it for a fee.

Only one Christmas buff can be active at a time. The fee will modify an already applied buff, not add a new one.

The cost of adding a new buff depends on the level of your character. You can find the cost information below:
❄Level 1~50: 10,000
❄Level 51~100: 50,000
❄Level 101~120: 100,000
❄Level 121~140: 120,000
❄Level 141~160: 140,000
❄Level 161~180: 160,000
❄Level 181~200: 180,000
