When you change, you can gain one of the following buffs:
❄Max HP
❄Max MP
❄Phys. attack
❄Magic Attack
❄Phys. defense
❄Mag. defense
❄Attack speed
❄ Speed of skill usage
❄Critical Attack Power
❄Crit chance

❗ Buff strength varies from 2% to 20% and is randomly assigned.

notes.title: NEW YEAR EVENT: LOYALISTS VS. REBELS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/37920c9b7b34fbc268ac213614cac25fae0ab48a.png[/img]

❄Oh-oh-oh-oh ❄

🦌A small accident (Rudolph got his feet tangled up again, what a reindeer) caused Santa Claus' sleigh to collapse right onto New Year's Valley. The elves, who had spent years making toys for obedient children, took advantage of this to organize a riot! With the help of the lost toys, they plan to raise their own army and break their fellow elves out from under the tyranny of Santa Claus. But they'll need help to collect the toys - it's pretty dangerous for these little creatures in New Year's Valley.

The elves, loyal to Santa Claus, are also collecting toys to save New Year's Eve, so the freedom fighters try to get ahead of them.

🎄When you first enter the game, you can automatically join the rebels or the loyalists. Look for the rebel leader in Katana and the loyalist leader in Laxi to move to a special dungeon, New Year's Valley. When hunting monsters in the New Year's Valley, you will be able to get toys to turn in to your team leader.

The choice of valley depends on the level of your character - if you have not yet reached level 150, you can choose the White Valley, which is home to monsters from level 20 to 149. The Red Valley is for characters of level 150 and above. The Black Valley makes sense if your level is above 160, and the Obsidian Valley is not worth going to unless you're at level 180.

The more toys you turn in, the more a special effect that increases all characteristics except luck will grow. The effect is applied to you when you enter the game and also affects your creatures.

While the event lasts, on two different days, the winning team will be able to get access to a purified demonic outfit, already sharpened to +24 and valid for 3 days.

But that's not all! In the New Year's Valley not only toys fall from the monsters, but also many useful things: Christmas decorative costumes, stamina stabilizers, bottles of the Fairy Goddess, potions of luck, a pass to the Hidden Village for 7 days, the blessing of the Maiden, the power of change: armor, armor of the conqueror of the Warped World, weapons and jewelry from the Circus and from the Island of Forgotten Gods, shields and jewelry from the Cursed Temple, blank cards of arena pets.

And the best part - from the final boss of the Black and Obsidian New Year's Valley you can get the Perfect Weapon Improvement Transfer Scroll!

Entry to New Year's Valley will close on January 22. Team Leaders will stay with you for another week so you can turn in your accumulated toys, and will disappear on January 29.

What are you waiting for? Let's go on a winter adventure!

notes.title: Merge of Panther-Kainen and Vulcano servers
notes.content:
Today the servers have been merged. Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, players of servers "Panther-Kainen" and "Vulcano" will now play together in one game world, and therefore will find new friends and opponents!

The Panther-Kainen and Vulcano servers have been merged into a single Panther-Vulcano (PvP) server.
▪ All characters, inventory, and everything related to a character have been moved with it to the merged server.
▪After the merge, the 8 characters you logged in last are available. If the selection of characters does not suit you, delete the extra characters and use the standard Rappelz / My character was deleted (for any reason) character recovery procedure. After the merge, the standard Rappelz character recovery procedure is available to all players, including non-GameXP Club members, up to and including December 6.
▪The quick access panel has been cleared for all characters on the merged servers. You will need to re-post skills and items to the panel to fill it up again.
▪When character names from the merged servers match, a postscript is added to both characters' names. They will soon be able to find a Character Name Change Ticket in the Gifts section of the in-game store, thanks to which they will be able to change their name.
▪If the guild names were the same on the merged servers, the guild with the highest number of players will retain the name. The guild that had fewer players will see an attribute in the guild name. You will need to write to tech support to change the name.
▪ The storekeeper only displays 1000 slots. If you do not find items from different servers in your chest after merging, you should pull items into your inventory so that there are less than 1000 items left in the chest and restart the game. If you do not find any items, write to tech support.
▪ All items placed before the server merge on the in-game auction remain on the in-game auction. If you do not find them, check the storekeeper.
▪GXP auction lots placed before the server merge will be returned to their owners.
▪ Dungeon ownership has been reset. It is necessary to recapture the dungeon.

We wish you exciting adventures on the merged server!

notes.title: Another event in honor of Halloween!
notes.content:
The adepts of the Necromancer Guild were not satisfied with the souls you brought them, so they gathered all their forces and summoned a huge number of monsters!
 
During the invasion, on the following time slots: 00:00, 06:00, 12:00 and 18:00 Moscow time, will appear event monsters and bosses. Each invasion lasts for 1 hour.
 
Remember that you can kill monsters indefinitely, but the boss can be defeated only once. Again to fight him you can only in a new time interval.
 
Each day you will be assigned to one of two teams automatically. This happens when you log in to the game, but if you have not re-logged in, you will only be assigned to a team after you kill a monster. The team with the most points will be rewarded. Gifts to the winners will be awarded the next day.
 
For winning you can receive:
🎃 Necromancer's Energy Crystal
🎃 Necromancer's Power Crystal
🎃 Necromancer's Dexterity Crystal.
🎃 Necromancer's skill crystal.
🎃 Necromancer's Intelligence Crystal
🎃 Necromancer's wisdom crystal.
🎃 Blessing of the Maiden gr.2 (1 hour)
🎃 Blessing of the Maiden (1 hour)
🎃 Fairy Goddess Bottle.
🎃 Book of Resurrection of Creatures.
🎃 Empty potion vial level 2.

For defeating the boss you can get:
🎃 Necromancer Crystals
🎃 Awakening Stones 1-7
🎃 Lusiad's Growth Potion
🎃Soul Stones
🎃Decorative permanent pet.

*May drop any of the following pets:
🎃Imp
🎃Teer of Death
🎃Demon Girl
🎃Cerber
🎃Tarantula
🎃Lilith
🎃 Scourge of the Eye
🎃Hobgoblin
🎃Skeleton
🎃 Zombie High Priest.
🎃 Zombie priest
🎃 Zombie temple knight.
🎃 Zombie Sailor

Players with level 1 to 150 earn 1 point for destroying a monster, while players with level above 151+ earn 10 points. You earn 100 points for defeating bosses with levels between 1 and 150, and 1000 points for defeating bosses above level 151+.
 
Note that when you destroy monsters or bosses with a level lower than yours, no points are awarded for your team. For example, if your level is 155 and you destroy a monster with a level between 101 and 150, you will receive no points for your team.
 
For players levels 1-50, the monsters that you can compete with are located in the Graveyard of Sorrow:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/a4eb7104e613a544bc4bbd8a318195360e6c8720.png[/img]

For players of levels 51-100, you can find monsters in the Palmyr Plateau area:

notes.title: Хэллоуин приходит в Rappelz!
notes.content:
The Halloween event is in full swing! We present you the second part of the event, during which you can get the same useful items as in the first part, as well as holiday costumes!
 
All Saints' Landing Pass has been added to your character's inventory! Contact a member of the Necromancer Guild to travel to this dungeon for one hour. The pass is issued once a day. When moving to the country of all saints, the pass disappears, and a special effect is applied to the character for an hour - while it is there, you can return to the dungeon if for some reason you decide to leave it earlier. After an hour, the characters are automatically moved to the city from the dungeon.
 
The level of the dungeon and the monsters in it depends on the level of the character: one dungeon for 20 - 169 levels and one for characters above level 170.
 
Magic artifacts already known to you fall from monsters:
pumpkin sweets that instantly restore health and mana,
necromancer crystals that increase certain stats by 66,
zombie nail (increases character height for 30 minutes),
creepy stamina stabilizers,
damn stamina cookie,
terrible potion (halloween version of luck potion),
Frankenstein Potion (Halloween version of BBF),
stat-boosting Halloween hats for 365 days,
card of the High Witch,
various charged particles of the Necromancer,
various pure parts of the Necromancer,
decorative Halloween pets for 28 days,
distorted zombie mask,
halloween cape surprise.
And most importantly - only from the monsters of the holiday dungeon you can get special costumes that, when printed, receive special characteristics, and you can open them with the help of a philosophical scroll. The lifetime of such suits is 1 year.
 
Is one dungeon a day not enough?
 
Then you should take a walk to the Necromancer's Cemetery, unless, of course, you are afraid!
To get there, you will need a special pass, which you can purchase from the in-game store. The Necromancer's Graveyard adjusts to your character's level just like the Vulcano Dungeon, and you can spend two hours there with one pass. Here you need to kill monsters to make one of the 4 bosses appear. When there are 10 monsters left, a boss will appear in the lower right corner of the map.
 
If you prefer not to go to dark places, then there is good news for you too - the first part of the event continues! Monsters still drop souls, and you can still exchange them with necromancers for buffs and useful items.
 
The event will end on November 20 during maintenance, and the necromancers will remain in Guy's world for another week, until November 27, so that you can exchange all the collected souls.

notes.title: Halloween is coming to Rappelz!
notes.content:
Did you feel it? Adherents of the necromancer guild recently emerged from the catacombs, bringing with them the smell of decay. Hungry for fresh souls, they will sell you anything to get them, and they will even share their dark power. These exiles may not look powerful enough, but don't underestimate them or you'll be damned forever!

Between October 23 and November 20, kill monsters and collect souls from them. In Horizon, Catana, Laxey, Rondo and in the Dead City you can find Halloween Stewards from the Necromancers Guild.

For 2 monster souls, you can receive a powerful aura from them for 2 hours, giving +66 to all characteristics except luck.

And for 1 soul - magical Halloween artifacts, including:
🎃pumpkin sweets that instantly restore health and mana,
🎃necromancer crystals that increase certain characteristics by 66,
🎃zombie nail (increases character growth for 30 minutes),
🎃terrible stamina stabilizers,
🎃damned stamina cookies,
🎃horrible potion (Halloween version of a good luck potion),
🎃Frankenstein's potion (Halloween version of BBF),
🎃stat-boosting Halloween hats for 365 days,
🎃High Witch card,
🎃various charged particles of the Necromancer,
🎃various pure particles of the Necromancer,
🎃decorative Halloween pets for 28 days,
🎃distorted zombie mask,
🎃Halloween surprise cape.

It is not necessary to exchange all collected souls one at a time - you can exchange 1, 10, 25 or 50 souls at once and receive a reward for each of them.

Upon entering the game, each character will receive a special effect that increases all of their characteristics, except luck, for 2 hours. The more monster souls players on your server turn over to Halloween stewards, the stronger the effect becomes. To update it, simply re-login to your character. Every day the buff is reset to 0.5% and accumulates again.

But that is not all! You will probably notice that adherents of the necromancer guild are talking about some kind of festive costumes. What is it? Follow the news carefully, and very soon you will find out everything!

We wish you a hell of a Halloween!

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/bdfdd0851ce9ae89abaddf649a7c63b0c7342e19.jpg[/img]

A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On October 22 from 12:00 to 13:00 (Moscow time) the Killer Hour will take place!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: JACKPOT OF GOLDEN LEAF FALL!
notes.content:
You are given a unique opportunity to take part in the Golden Leaf Fall Jackpot.

🔥What is Jackpot?

Jackpot is a great opportunity to get some of the most expensive and useful products at a mind-blowing discount, and also win GXP!
The final size of the Jackpot is not limited and its current amount is available on the main page of the site!

🔥How is the prize fund formed?

When purchasing each product, a portion of the funds is transferred to the accumulative Jackpot prize fund, which will be drawn among the participants! The amount accumulated during the promotion period will be drawn at the end of the promotion on September 30 between Rappelz players participating in the Jackpot.

🔥How does the award ceremony take place?

A prize of 50% of the accumulated amount will be received by 1 winner, and the remaining 50% will be distributed among the remaining 5 winners.

🔥When will I be able to find out the results and receive my reward?

Jackpot results will be announced within 3 business days after the end of the promotion.

Winning GXP will be credited to winners' accounts within three business days.

You can take part in the jackpot from September 15 to September 29 (inclusive).

notes.title: Boss hunt
notes.content:
Residents of Rappelz!

It's time to explore all the hidden corners of Guy's world. Some of them may not have had any characters set foot in them, but that's about to change! After all, this is where the person you are looking for can hide!

48 different types of monsters (2 types of each boss) of 150-200 levels will appear in various territories, with the exception of the Training Island and dungeons. Your task is to find them in time and kill them. After the death of a monster, the player who dealt it the final blow receives one of the special rewards in random amounts:
Battle Arena Crystal Crate
Battle Arena Potions Box
Sweet bread
sweet water
A card with a random buff spell
Endurance Stabilizer
Endurance Cookie
Fairy goddess bottle
Mighty Scroll of Taming Creature
Giant's Nail
Potion of Luck
Creature Resurrection Book
Event Dark Cube
Red Creature Potion
Empty potion bottle
Altered Particles of Power
Refined Motes of Power
The energy of gold
Blessing of the Virgin
Blessed Power of Change: Armor
Attack element of the moon
Box with numbers
Protection powder
Recovery Powder

Monsters have different difficulty levels, and the more difficult the monster (depending on the level and characteristics), the greater the chance of getting an additional reward for it (2 items from the list instead of one).
The resurrection time of monsters is 1 minute, but remember that they can resurrect in a completely different place!

And the most important thing! After the end of the event, the player of each server who has killed the most event bosses will receive a special reward from us - a pass to the Hidden Village for 90 days!

Good luck!

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/bdfdd0851ce9ae89abaddf649a7c63b0c7342e19.jpg[/img]

A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On September, the 6th, from 21:00 to 22:00 (UTC), the Hour of the Killer will be held!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: The Clash of Towns event has begun!
notes.content:
🔥The Clash of Towns event has begun in the world of Rappelz!🔥
 
When you first enter the game, your character automatically falls into one of three teams: Laxey, Horizon or Katana.
 
Near Laxey, Horizon, Katana and Rondo, bosses with the names “Team Laxey”, “Team Horizon” and so on begin to appear.
If a team kills their own boss, they get 10 points.
If a team kills another team's boss, they receive 10% of that team's total score.

For example: Team Laxy kills the boss in Horizon. Team Horizon loses 10% of their points. Before the boss is killed they have 80 points, after the boss is killed by Laxy's team they have 72 points.
 
Respawn time for bosses in Laxey, Horizon and Katana is 1 hour. The boss that spawns in Rondo has a respawn time of 3 hours. Killing this boss gives the team 50 points.
 
When a team kills a boss, a world buff is applied to them for 5 minutes. While it's active, you can meet with your team's NPCs and receive a reward (one randomized enhanced transformation potion that lasts 30 minutes and gives an increase of 5% to damage; the transformation is removed by double-clicking on the buff).
 
When a character receives a reward, the buff is removed from him.
 
At the end of the event, teams receive rewards according to their rating.
 
The first place team receives:
🔹200 Fire Energy
🔹200 Water Energy
🔹200 Wind Energy
🔹5 wings

Second place:
🔹120 Fire Energies
🔹120 Water Energies
🔹120 Wind Energy
🔹2 wings

Third place:
🔹70 Fire Energies
🔹70 Water Energies
🔹70 Wind Energy
🔹1 wings

The player chooses the wings himself, depending on the class and preferences in appearance. The wings are temporary.
 
The event will end on July 17th. You will be able to pick up the rewards from the NPC before maintenance on July 24th.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: The new server Vulcano is waiting for its heroes!
Merge of Panther-Siren and Kainen servers
notes.content:
Dear players!

Servers have been merged today. Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, the players of the Panther-Siren and Kainen servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

Servers "Panther-Siren" and "Kinen" are merged into a single server "Panther-Kinen" (PvP).
⬜️ All characters, inventory, and everything related to the character have been transferred with him to the unified server.
⬜️ After merging, 8 characters are available, which you visited last. If the choice of characters does not suit you, delete the extra ones, and use the standard procedure for restoring characters Rappelz / My character was deleted (for whatever reason). After the merger, the standard procedure for restoring Rappelz characters is available to all players, including non-GameXP Club members, until July 16 inclusive.
⬜️ The quick access bar has been cleared for all the characters of the combined servers. In order to fill it up again, you need to re-put the skills and items on the bar.
⬜️ If the names of characters from the combined servers match, a postscript is added to the names of both characters. In the near future, they will be able to find a Character Change Ticket in the "Gifts" section of the game store, thanks to which they will be able to change their name.
⬜️ If the merged servers had the same guild names, the name will be kept by the guild with the most players. A guild that had fewer players will see a postscript in the guild name. To change the name, you will need to write to technical support.
⬜️ Storekeeper only displays 1000 slots. If, after merging, you did not find items from different servers in the chest, you need to pull the items into your inventory so that there are less than 1000 items left in the chest and restart the game. If you did not find any items, write to technical support.
⬜️ All items placed before the server merge in the in-game auction remained in the auction. If you don't find them, check with the storekeeper.
⬜️ GXP Auction lots placed before the server merge will be returned to their owners.
⬜️ Dungeon ownership reset. You need to retake the dungeon.
 
We wish you exciting adventures on the united server!

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On June, 17, from 21:00 to 22:00 (UTC), the Hour of the Killer will be held!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: Boss hunt
notes.content:
Residents of Rappelz!

It's time to explore all the hidden corners of Guy's world. Some of them may not have had any characters set foot in them, but that's about to change! After all, this is where the person you are looking for can hide!

From August 22 to September 5, 48 different types of monsters (2 types of each boss) of 150-200 levels will appear in various territories, with the exception of the Training Island and dungeons. Your task is to find them in time and kill them. After the death of a monster, the player who dealt it the final blow receives one of the special rewards in random amounts:
Battle Arena Crystal Crate
Battle Arena Potions Box
Sweet bread
sweet water
A card with a random buff spell
Endurance Stabilizer
Endurance Cookie
Fairy goddess bottle
Mighty Scroll of Taming Creature
Giant's Nail
Potion of Luck
Creature Resurrection Book
Event Dark Cube
Red Creature Potion
Empty potion bottle
Altered Particles of Power
Refined Motes of Power
The energy of gold
Blessing of the Virgin
Blessed Power of Change: Armor
Attack element of the moon
Box with numbers
Protection powder
Recovery Powder

Monsters have different difficulty levels, and the more difficult the monster (depending on the level and characteristics), the greater the chance of getting an additional reward for it (2 items from the list instead of one).
The resurrection time of monsters is 1 minute, but remember that they can resurrect in a completely different place!

And the most important thing! After the end of the event, the player of each server who has killed the most event bosses will receive a special reward from us - a pass to the Hidden Village for 90 days!

Good luck!

notes.content:
Right now and until the start of technical work on April 3, the event "Tame and Harvest" is in effect for you!

How it works?

From any monster, when killed or tamed, you can get a special box. Opening it will give you one of the following items:

[list]

notes.title: Horizon is in danger!
notes.content:
Want to know how to increase the server buff this weekend and get useful loot?
 
The monsters of Guy's world, who are tired of the constant hunting for them, continue their riot! Templar Guild intelligence reports: the monsters are planning a new attack on the already suspicious Horizon! The smuggler of the Nostra clan managed to overhear their plot again, and this is what he told!
 
The attack will take place this Friday at the Horizon field:
[list]
[*] Kainen - 17:30 Moscow time
[*] Panther-Siren - 18:00 Moscow time
[*] Angel Minotaur - 18:30 UTC
[/list]

The energy of the dead monsters will increase the server buff this weekend: each killed Reviak will increase the level of the "Necromancer's Power" buff (+0.5% to all characteristics) by 1! And of course, the defenders of the city will be able to get loot from the bosses!
 
Good luck defenders!

notes.title: Epic 9.8 - Labyrinth of Light - already on the servers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/b7843672635f9022b0c5400593852537cf61d38c.png[/img]

Epic 9.8 "Labyrinth of Light" is already in the game!

[h1]General changes[/h1]

Increased character level cap to 240 and profession level cap to 120.
 
All first skills in the OT branches have been added to the 3rd level of study (at level 116 of the profession).
2 levels of learning have been added to skill enhancement skills for OT.
Below you can see the profession level required to level up the skill-enhancement of certain skills (from left to right in the skill tree):
[list]
[*] Skill 1 - Level 8 - at profession level 115
[*] Skill 1 - Level 9 - At profession level 118
[*] Skill 2 - Level 8 - at profession level 116
[*] Skill 2 - Level 9 - at profession level 119
[*] Skill 3 - Level 8 - at profession level 117
[*] Skill 3 - Level 9 - at profession level 120
[/list]
You also have the opportunity to further upgrade various passive skills at profession levels above 115.
 
In the Sky Fortress, the drop rate of loot has been increased - now it has become easier to collect sky accessories.
 
Coin Exchange Assistant can now open up to 5000 Skill Card Boxes at a time
 
Certain items now drop in boxes and can stack in one inventory slot:
[list]
[*] Creature Skill Artifact
[*] Soul of Mortis
[*] Ring of the Horadric
[*] Blue Kainen Necklace
[*] Red Kainen Earring
[*] Janua Mirror
[*] Shield of Janua
[/list]
Significantly reduced the weight of various items, including:
[list]
[*] Red Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Improved Red Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Blue Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Improved Blue Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Resurrection Scroll
[*] Creature Resurrection Book
[*] Sweet bread
[*] sweet water
[*] Red and blue gladiator potions
[*] Boxes with food, crystals and arena potions
[*] Keys
[*] Demonic Crystals can now be placed in storage.
[/list]
 
The limit of buffs that buff refresh scrolls and pet refresh scrolls work with has been expanded (now there will be more buffs that can be extended).
 
Perfect Block now has a cap of 70%.

[h1]New dungeon[/h1]

In epic 9.8, an important place is given to the new dungeon, from which it takes its name - "Labyrinth of Light".
 
You can get into the labyrinth starting from level 200 - it is on it that you will open a special chain of quests necessary to enter. Everything will start at the Messenger of the Community, Luciad Ruf, on the pier of the Dead City with the task “A Forgotten Reason”, and after a few quests you will find yourself in the Templar Refuge, where the entrance to the dungeon is located. Gather a party, it's not safe there!
 
Entering the dungeon, you will find yourself in a kind of "foyer" - on a small platform, surrounded on all sides by darkness. Use the login device to go further.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/3cf22227f1c5bcad4e885b611e31fe30c69e29a2.png[/img]

The maze of light consists of 16 arena rooms that you have to go through, moving along the chain. How exactly to get through? Of course, kill all living things. But there is a catch: for the whole journey you are given 30 minutes and not a second more. The good news is that arenas can be jumped over. To do this, you only need a little knowledge.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/b6977ef43bc5bfa32a17d6293fb867fb06d41cd2.png[/img]

The monsters in each arena are approximately the same, they differ only in level - the farther, the stronger they are. So, your goal is to kill everyone, and as quickly as possible - the less time it takes, the better the final reward will be.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/6641bdc284c1984d7c7e515ba1370f6566482ebe.jpg[/img]

Each time you kill a guardian of rank A (B, C or D), all members of the group will be shown information about the remaining time and the number of the core of the Guard.
 
The number must be remembered (if you forget, just click on the sphere that remains after the death of the Guardian).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/b609fc6b0d611906a53e1519fb915f4aa4a20bc0.png[/img]

When all four Guardians are killed, add up their numbers and go with this knowledge to the portal with the tablets opposite the entrance.
 
Each tablet is a statement about your final number:
[list]
[*] This number is prime - true/false
[*] Is this fibonacci number true/false
[*] This number is even - True/False
[*] This number is square - true/false
[/list]
When the plate is up, it is in the True position, and when it is down, it is in the False position.
 
For example, the numbers of the core of the Guardians you killed are 2, 6, 4 and 3. Add these numbers and get 15. We look at the plates whether these statements are true or false for the number 15, put them in the right position and use the device to enter.
 
Each correct answer is a missed room, meaning with 4 correct answers you will move 4 rooms forward. If you answer all 4 questions incorrectly, you will be moved to the beginning.
 
At the tablets in the first room you will meet Templar Oui. Take the Quiz King quest from him to get an extra talent point as a reward!
 
In the last room you will find a chest with a reward. For every minute left on the timer by the time you get there, you will receive a 1% bonus to loot from the chest. The chest is opened by one member of the group, and everyone receives the reward.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/a90406f444a1a4189935140d0171aec4166f85e7.png[/img]

By the way, if you are a convinced humanist or just don’t want to remember what “fibonacci” is, then keep a small cheat sheet:
 
[h1]New weapon[/h1]

Update 9.8 contains new weapons and shields. The good news is that it's crafted from your old weapon, so valuable stats, upgrades, and soul gems will stay with you.
 
So, to upgrade your weapon from the Isle of the Forgotten Gods, you will need:
[list]
[*] the main enchantment slot is your weapon from the Island,
[*] auxiliary cell - a similar unfinished weapon from the Circus (can be unopened),
[*] Material slot - Luciad's Pure Energy (25 for one-handed weapons and 50 for two-handed weapons).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/fb5aeb71307b402e7e44bd713f6cf26a8bdae7e2.png[/img]

The pure energy of Luciad can be obtained in the Labyrinth of Light.
 
After the change, the required weapon level becomes 210.

[h1]Upgrade after +20[/h1]

The enchant system up to +25, which has already become familiar, has undergone significant changes in epic 9.8. First of all, the maximum level of improvement is now +20, and further improvement comes from increasing the strength of Luciad.
 
As soon as your item becomes +20, it gains 1 level of Luciad's power.
 
Luciad's maximum power level is +32 for all old armor and weapons, and 40 for new pure white weapons and shields.
 
To increase the power level of Luciad, you will need to place the following items in the enchantment window:
[list]
[*] the main enchantment slot is your weapon or armor,
[*] auxiliary cell - Luciad's power: weapons / armor,
[*] material slot - pure or improved Luciad's cube.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/4dc8d30fb833730ecc98553ea32c0149981d28f1.png[/img]

You can get Luciad Power for a weapon by combining any weapon that has at least one level of Luciad Power with the Luciad Power Extractor (purchased from a blacksmith for 200,000,000).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/6a3b62193aad4bf435a65ae61ead216b92c98ca6.png[/img]

The number of Extractors needed corresponds to the Luciad's power level of the original item: for example, to extract power from a weapon with a power level of 32, you would need 32 Extractors. Same with armor if you want to get Luciad's power for armor.
 
The Pure Cube of Luciad is used to boost Luciad's strength to +32 and below. You can get it as a drop from any bosses above level 150 or from the chest of the Labyrinth of Light.
 
Improved Luciad's Cube is needed to increase Luciad's strength from +33 to 40. You can get it in the Labyrinth of Light.
 
But what about things that have already been enchanted above +20? Don't worry, they will automatically change and get the Luciad power upgrade corresponding to their level of enchantment (statistics will not change):
Before -> Now (Luciad's power level)
[list]
[*] 20 -> 1
[*] 21 -> 2
[*] 22 -> 4
[*] 23 -> 8
[*] 24 -> 16
[*] 25 -> 32
[/list]

[h1]Awakening for weapons and accessories[/h1]

If earlier the number of lines in the awakening of weapons and accessories was 5, now you can increase their number to 7, as well as change some options at your discretion.
 
To do this, you will need special awakening stones: Blessed Awakening Stone and Blessed Awakening Stone: accessories.
 
To get a stone of blessed awakening, combine a regular stone of awakening with the pure energy of Luciad. Similarly - with a stone for accessories.
 
If you are not satisfied with any of the proposed options, but like all the others, you can easily change just one line with the help of awakening stone I - VII.
 
Here's how it works: choose which stitch you want to change and apply the appropriate stone.
Awakening stones for one line are purchased in the game store.

[h1]Soul Stones[/h1]

Serene Soul Stones (2) can now be upgraded to +5 or +10 with Energy Master. To upgrade to +5, you need Soulstone Essence (obtained in Labyrinth of Light).
 
Place the items of equipment that you want to improve the gems in in the Soul Gem Management window of the Energy Master. Place the essence of the soul stone in the bottom cell. Click on the button below the stone you want to upgrade.
 
Upgrading above +5 will require Unstable Soulstone Essence (purchased from the in-game store).
 
You can find out what characteristics the improvement will bring to each stone in the knowledge base.
 
We wish you good luck in exploring the Labyrinth of Light and, of course, have fun playing!

notes.title: Epic 9.8. Skills, innovations and other important points
notes.content:
In the final test diary, we will talk about skill changes and some other nice and useful changes.
 
As you already know, the maximum character level has been increased to 240, and the profession level has been increased to 120.
 
All first skills in the OT branches have been added to the 3rd level of study (at level 116 of the profession).
2 levels of learning have been added to skill enhancement skills for OT.
Below you can see the profession level required to level up the skill-enhancement of certain skills (from left to right in the skill tree):
[list]
[*] 1 skill — level 8 — at profession level 115
[*] 1 skill - level 9 - at 118 profession level
[*] Skill 2 — level 8 — at profession level 116
[*] Skill 2 — level 9 — at profession level 119
[*] Skill 3 — level 8 — at profession level 117
[*] Skill 3 — level 9 — at profession level 120
[/list]
You also have the opportunity to further upgrade various passive skills at profession levels above 115.
 
And to other useful innovations.
 
In the Sky Fortress, the drop rate of loot has been increased - now it has become easier to collect sky accessories.
 
Certain items now drop in boxes and can stack in one inventory slot:
[list]
[*] Creature skill artifact
[*] Soul of Mortis
[*] Ring of the Horadric
[*] Blue Kainen Necklace
[*] Red Kainen Earring
[*] Janua Mirror
[*] Janua Shield
[/list]
Significantly reduced the weight of various items, including:
[list]
[*] Red Potion lvl 2 – 10
[*] Improved Red Potion lvl 2 – 10
[*] Blue Potion lvl 2 – 10
[*] Improved Blue Potion lvl 2 – 10
[*] Resurrection Scroll
[*] Creature Resurrection Book
[*] Sweet bread
[*] Sweet water
[*] Red and blue gladiator potions
[*] Boxes with food, crystals and arena potions
[*] Keys
[/list]
Demonic Crystals can now be placed in storage.
 
The limit of buffs that buff refresh scrolls and pet refresh scrolls work with has been expanded (now there will be more buffs that can be extended).
 
Perfect Block now has a cap of 70%.
 
That, perhaps, is all we want to tell you about the changes in epic 9.8. The update is very close, and very soon you will be able to try it out yourself!

notes.title: Hour of the killer
notes.content:
A black shadow, as if woven from darkness, silently appeared at the gates of Katana. Silently she slipped into the city, illuminated for a moment by the cold light of the impassive moon, and then hid, waiting.

Mortul Kane, the last accomplice of the Brotherhood of Death, who has sunk into oblivion, has returned to Guy's world in order to restore the former foundations and revive the ancient order of assassins! Long ago, the Brotherhood of Death and its Executioners brought terror and death, reaping lives and collecting bloody tribute.

Those brave men who are not afraid to look into the eyes of Death itself and risk joining the Brotherhood will gain power and will keep Guy's world in fear!
Recruits must pass a ruthless test and only the most brutal recruit will be honored to become one of the Executioners of the Brotherhood of Death!

On December 24th, from 21:00 to 22:00 (UTC), the Hour of the Killer will be held!

The one who kills the most players during this time will be the winner of the challenge and receive:

[list]
[*] Ancient gold energy (10 pcs)
[*] Powder of recovery (1 pc)
[*] Hidden Village Pass (7 days)
[/list]

Remember that your victims must be at least level 150! Kill as many different characters as possible!
(1 server - 1 winner)

We remind you that this event is not held on the Angel-Minotaur PvE server.

notes.title: The new server "Kainen" opens the doors!
Panther-Siren and Reviak servers merge
notes.content:
Dear players!
 
Servers have been merged today. Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, the players of the Panther-Siren and Reviak servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

The Panther-Siren and Reviak servers are merged into a single Panther-Reviak server (PvP).
[list]
[*] All characters, inventory, and everything related to the character have been transferred with him to the unified server.
[*] After merging, 8 characters are available, which you accessed last. If the choice of characters does not suit you, remove the extra ones, and the remaining characters will appear as the slots become free. If you accidentally deleted the wrong one, you need to use the standard Rappelz character recovery procedure / My character was deleted (for whatever reason). After the merger, the standard Rappelz character recovery procedure is available to all players, including non-GameXP Club members, until January 12th.
[*] The quick access panel has been cleared for all characters of the combined servers. In order to fill it up again, you need to re-put the skills and items on the bar.
[*] If the names of the characters from the combined servers match, the names of both characters are appended with the server number. They will be able to find a Character Name Change Ticket in the Gifts section of the in-game store, thanks to which they will be able to change their name.
[*] If there were identical guild names on the merged servers, the name will be saved for the guild with the largest number of players. A guild that had fewer players will see a postscript in the guild name. To change the name, you will need to write to technical support.
[*] Storekeeper displays only 1000 slots. If, after merging, you did not find items from different servers in the chest, you need to pull the items into your inventory so that there are less than 1000 items left in the chest and restart the game. If you did not find any items, write to technical support.
[*] All lots that were put up before the merging of servers in the in-game auction remained at the auction. If you don't find them, check with the storekeeper.
[*] GXP auction lots placed before the server merge will be returned to their owners.
[*] Dungeon ownership has been reset. You need to retake the dungeon.
[/list]
We wish you exciting adventures on the united server!

notes.title: Loyal against rebels: New Year event in Rappelz
notes.content:
Oh oh oh!
 
As a result of a small accident (Rudolf got tangled in his legs again, here is a deer), Santa Claus's sleigh fell right into New Year's Valley. The elves, who have been making toys for obedient children for years, have taken advantage of this to start a riot! With the help of their lost toys, they plan to raise their own army and wrest their fellows from the tyranny of Santa Claus. But they will need help to collect toys - New Year's Valley is quite dangerous for these little creatures.

The elves loyal to Santa Claus are also collecting toys to save the New Year, so the freedom fighters are trying to get ahead of them.
 
When you first enter the game, you can automatically join the rebels or the faithful. Look for the leader of the rebels in Katana, and the leader of the faithful in Laxey to move to a special dungeon - New Year's Valley. When hunting monsters in New Year's Valley, you will be able to get toys that you have to turn in to the leader of your team.
 
The choice of the valley depends on the level of your character - if you have not reached level 150 yet, the White Valley is at your service, where monsters from level 30 to 165 live. Red Valley is for characters level 150 and above. It makes sense to look into the Black Valley if your level exceeds 160, and you should not go to Obsidian until you have reached 180.
 
The more toys you turn in, the more the special effect will increase, increasing all characteristics except luck. The effect is applied to you when you enter the game and affects your creatures as well.
 
During the duration of the event, on two different days, the winning team will be able to access Refined Demonic Equipment, already enchanted to +24 and valid for 3 days.
 
But that's not all! In the New Year's Valley, not only toys fall from monsters, but also many useful things: Christmas decorative costumes, stamina stabilizers, bottles of the fairy goddess, luck potions, a pass to the Hidden Village for 7 days, the blessing of the Virgin, the power of change: armor, the armor of the conqueror of the Distorted world, weapons and jewelry from the Circus and the Isle of the Forgotten Gods, shields and jewelry from the Cursed Temple, empty arena pet cards.
 
And the most interesting - from the final boss of the Black and Obsidian New Year's Valley, you can get the Perfect Weapon Upgrade Transfer Scroll!
 
Entrance to New Year's Valley will close on January 23rd. The team leaders will stay with you for another week so that you can turn in the accumulated toys, and will disappear on January 30th.
 
What are you waiting for? Onward to winter adventures!

notes.title: Хэллоуин приходит в Rappelz!
notes.content:
The Halloween event is in full swing! We present you the second part of the event, during which you can get the same useful items as in the first part, as well as holiday costumes!
 
All Saints' Landing Pass has been added to your character's inventory! Contact a member of the Necromancer Guild to travel to this dungeon for one hour. The pass is issued once a day. When moving to the country of all saints, the pass disappears, and a special effect is applied to the character for an hour - while it is there, you can return to the dungeon if for some reason you decide to leave it earlier. After an hour, the characters are automatically moved to the city from the dungeon.
 
The level of the dungeon and the monsters in it depends on the level of the character: one dungeon for 20 - 169 levels and one for characters above level 170.
 
Magic artifacts already known to you fall from monsters:
pumpkin sweets that instantly restore health and mana,
necromancer crystals that increase certain stats by 66,
zombie nail (increases character height for 30 minutes),
creepy stamina stabilizers,
damn stamina cookie,
terrible potion (halloween version of luck potion),
Frankenstein Potion (Halloween version of BBF),
stat-boosting Halloween hats for 365 days,
card of the High Witch,
various charged particles of the Necromancer,
various pure parts of the Necromancer,
decorative Halloween pets for 28 days,
distorted zombie mask,
halloween cape surprise.
And most importantly - only from the monsters of the holiday dungeon you can get special costumes that, when printed, receive special characteristics, and you can open them with the help of a philosophical scroll. The lifetime of such suits is 1 year.
 
Is one dungeon a day not enough?
 
Then you should take a walk to the Necromancer's Cemetery, unless, of course, you are afraid!
To get there, you will need a special pass, which you can purchase from the in-game store. The Necromancer's Graveyard adjusts to your character's level just like the Vulcano Dungeon, and you can spend two hours there with one pass. Here you need to kill monsters to make one of the 4 bosses appear. When there are 10 monsters left, a boss will appear in the lower right corner of the map.
 
If you prefer not to go to dark places, then there is good news for you too - the first part of the event continues! Monsters still drop souls, and you can still exchange them with necromancers for buffs and useful items.
 
The event will end on November 21 during maintenance, and the necromancers will remain in Guy's world for another week, until November 28, so that you can exchange all the collected souls.

notes.title: Хэллоуин приходит в Rappelz!
notes.content:
Halloween is coming to Rappelz!

Did you feel? Adherents of the Necromancer's Guild have recently emerged from the catacombs, bringing with them the smell of decay. Hungry for fresh souls, they are willing to sell you anything to get them, and they will even share their dark power. These exiles may not look powerful enough, but don't underestimate them or you'll be damned forever!

From October 24 to November 21, kill monsters and collect souls from them. In Horizon, Katana, Laxey, Rondo and Dead City, you can find Halloween Stewards from the Necromancer Guild.

For 2 souls of monsters, you can get a powerful aura from them for 2 hours, giving +66 to all characteristics except luck.

And for 1 soul - magical Halloween artifacts, including:
pumpkin sweets that instantly restore health and mana,
necromancer crystals that increase certain stats by 66,
zombie nail (increases character height for 30 minutes),
creepy stamina stabilizers,
damn stamina cookie,
terrible potion (halloween version of luck potion),
Frankenstein Potion (Halloween version of BBF),
stat-boosting Halloween hats for 365 days,
card of the High Witch,
various charged particles of the Necromancer,
various pure parts of the Necromancer,
decorative Halloween pets for 28 days,
distorted zombie mask,
halloween cape surprise.

It is not necessary to exchange all the collected souls one at a time - you can exchange 1, 10, 25 or 50 souls at once and receive a reward for each of them.

Upon entering the game, each character will receive a special effect that increases all his characteristics for 2 hours, except for luck. The more monster souls your server players turn in to the Halloween stewards, the stronger the effect becomes. To update it, just re-login to the character. Every day the buff resets to 0.5% and accumulates again.

But that's not all! You will probably notice that the adherents of the necromancers guild are talking about some kind of festive costumes. What is it? Follow the news carefully, and very soon you will find out everything!

We wish you a hell of a fun Halloween!

notes.title: Clash of the cities!
notes.content:
An event has begun in the world of Rappelz!
 
When you first enter the game, your character automatically falls into one of three teams: Laxey, Horizon or Katana.
 
Near Laxey, Horizon, Katana and Rondo, bosses with the names “Team Laxey”, “Team Horizon” and so on begin to appear.
If a team kills their own boss, they get 10 points.
If a team kills another team's boss, they receive 10% of that team's total score.

For example: Team Laxy kills the boss in Horizon. Team Horizon loses 10% of their points. Before the boss is killed they have 80 points, after the boss is killed by Laxy's team they have 72 points.
 
Respawn time for bosses in Laxey, Horizon and Katana is 1 hour. The boss that spawns in Rondo has a respawn time of 3 hours. Killing this boss gives the team 50 points.
 
When a team kills a boss, they get a world buff for 5 minutes. While it's active, you can meet with your team's NPCs and receive a reward (one randomized enhanced transformation potion that lasts 30 minutes and gives an increase of 5% to damage; the transformation is removed by double-clicking on the buff).
 
When a character receives a reward, the buff is removed from him.
 
At the end of the event, teams receive rewards according to their rating.
 
The first place team receives:
200 Fire Energy
200 Water Energy
200 Wind Energy
5 wings

Second place:
120 Energy of fire
120 Energy Water
120 Wind Energy
2 wings

Third place:
70 Energy of fire
70 Energy Water
70 Wind Energy
1 wings

The player chooses the wings himself, depending on the class and preferences in appearance. The wings are temporary.
 
The event will end on October 17th. You can collect the rewards from the NPC before maintenance on October 24th.
 
Good luck!

To avoid failure and increase your chances of good bonuses, Magic Powder (purchased in the game store) will help. Add it to the enchant window when using a shard for better results.

notes.title: Boss hunt
notes.content:
Residents of Rappelz!

It's time to explore all the hidden corners of Guy's world. Some of them may not have had any characters set foot in them, but that's about to change! After all, this is where the person you are looking for can hide!

From August 22 to September 5, 48 different types of monsters (2 types of each boss) of 150-200 levels will appear in various territories, with the exception of the Training Island and dungeons. Your task is to find them in time and kill them. After the death of a monster, the player who dealt it the final blow receives one of the special rewards in random amounts:
Battle Arena Crystal Crate
Battle Arena Potions Box
Sweet bread
sweet water
A card with a random buff spell
Endurance Stabilizer
Endurance Cookie
Fairy goddess bottle
Mighty Scroll of Taming Creature
Giant's Nail
Potion of Luck
Creature Resurrection Book
Event Dark Cube
Red Creature Potion
Empty potion bottle
Altered Particles of Power
Refined Motes of Power
The energy of gold
Blessing of the Virgin
Blessed Power of Change: Armor
Attack element of the moon
Box with numbers
Protection powder
Recovery Powder

Monsters have different difficulty levels, and the more difficult the monster (depending on the level and characteristics), the greater the chance of getting an additional reward for it (2 items from the list instead of one).
The resurrection time of monsters is 1 minute, but remember that they can resurrect in a completely different place!

And the most important thing! After the end of the event, the player of each server who has killed the most event bosses will receive a special reward from us - a pass to the Hidden Village for 90 days!

Good luck!

notes.title: Summer wedding event
notes.content:
Summer is the season for weddings, and Rappelz is no exception! (No, you don't have to get married yet, unless you want to, of course), but the wedding planner Cleopatra will be very grateful if you help her with the preparations.
 
While the event lasts, 6 types of special wedding items can be obtained from all monsters in Guy's world:
[list]
[*] Cosmetics,
[*] Hair Jewelry,
[*] Bouquet,
[*] Wedding Shoes,
[*] Wedding ring,
[*] Wedding Dress.
[/list]
 
After collecting everything, take them to Cleopatra to receive a special holiday box.
 
Opening it will give you one of the following items:
[list]
[*] Wind energy - 2 pcs
[*] Water energy - 2 pcs
[*] Fire energy - 2 pcs
[*] Box with a wedding ring (+100 to all characteristics, except for luck, for a day)
[*] Fairy goddess bottle — 3 pcs
[*] Mighty Scroll of Taming a Creature — 5 pcs
[*] Blessing of the Virgin
[*] Box with numbers
[*] Creature Resurrection Book
[*] Gold Energy (2)
[*] Attack element of the moon
[*] Potion of Luck
[*] Endurance Stabilizer
[*] dark cube
[*] Magnificent Experience Potion
[*] Stability map
[*] Ancient Magic Cube
[*] mirror map
[*] Demon Hourglass
[*] Blessed Ancient Attack Cube*
[*] Blessed Ancient Protection Cube*
[*] Protection powder
[/list]
*Please note that when using the above dice, the item becomes character-bound.
 
You can get such a box 1 time per day. However, if you happen to get the New Wedding Plan, you can bypass this limitation - using it gives you +1 opportunity to trade.
 
A new wedding plan can be obtained from monsters with a small chance, as well as bought from Leonardo's character in Rondo (no more than 10 times a day). The more plans you buy, the more Rs you spend.
 
Every fifth box you receive, up to the 150th, will bring you an additional reward:

The event will end on August 15 during maintenance. The exchange NPCs will stay with you for another week after the exchange ends.
 
Good luck!
